**Table 8-46. CXL defined Command Return Codes (Vendor ID = 1E98h or 0000h) (Sheet 1 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Value</th><th>Definition</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>0000h</td><td><strong>Success:</strong> The command successfully completed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0001h</td><td><strong>Background Command Started:</strong> The background command successfully started. Refer to the Background Command Status register to retrieve the command result.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0002h</td><td><strong>Invalid Input:</strong> A command input was invalid.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0003h</td><td><strong>Unsupported:</strong> The command is not supported.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0004h</td><td><strong>Internal Error:</strong> The command was not completed because of an internal device error.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0005h</td><td><strong>Retry Required:</strong> The command was not completed because of a temporary error. An optional single retry may resolve the issue.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0006h</td><td><strong>Busy:</strong> The device is currently busy processing a background operation. Wait until background command completes and then retry the command.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0007h</td><td><strong>Media Disabled:</strong> The command could not be completed because it requires media access and media is disabled.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0008h</td><td><strong>FW Transfer in Progress:</strong> Only one FW package can be transferred at a time. Complete the current FW package transfer before starting a new one.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0009h</td><td><strong>FW Transfer Out of Order:</strong> The FW package transfer was aborted because the FW package content was transferred out of order.</td></tr>
<tr><td>000Ah</td><td><strong>FW Verification Failed:</strong> The FW package was not saved to the device because the FW package verification failed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>000Bh</td><td><strong>Invalid Slot:</strong> The FW slot specified is not supported or not valid for the requested operation.</td></tr>
<tr><td>000Ch</td><td><strong>Activation Failed, FW Rolled Back:</strong> The new FW failed to activate and rolled back to the previous active FW.</td></tr>
<tr><td>000Dh</td><td><strong>Activation Failed, Cold Reset Required:</strong> The new FW failed to activate. A cold reset is required.</td></tr>
<tr><td>000Eh</td><td><strong>Invalid Handle:</strong> One or more Event Record Handles were invalid or specified out of order.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-46. CXL defined Command Return Codes (Vendor ID = 1E98h or 0000h) (Sheet 2 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Value</th><th>Definition</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>000Fh</td><td><strong>Invalid Physical Address:</strong> The physical address specified is invalid.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0010h</td><td><strong>Inject Poison Limit Reached:</strong> The device's limit on allowed poison injection has been reached. Clear injected poison requests before attempting to inject more.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0011h</td><td><strong>Permanent Media Failure:</strong> The device could not clear poison because of a permanent issue with the media.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0012h</td><td><strong>Aborted:</strong> The background command was aborted by the device, either on its own or as a result of a Request Abort Background Operation command.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0013h</td><td><strong>Invalid Security State:</strong> The command is invalid in the current security state.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0014h</td><td><strong>Incorrect Passphrase:</strong> The passphrase does not match the currently set passphrase.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0015h</td><td><strong>Unsupported Mailbox or CCI:</strong> The command is not supported on the mailbox or CCI it was issued on.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0016h</td><td><strong>Invalid Payload Length:</strong> The input payload length specified for the command is invalid or exceeds the component's Maximum Supported Message Size. The device is required to perform this check prior to processing any command defined in this specification.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0017h</td><td><strong>Invalid Log:</strong> The log page is not supported or not valid.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0018h</td><td><strong>Interrupted:</strong> The command could not be successfully completed because of an asynchronous event.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0019h</td><td><strong>Unsupported Feature Version:</strong> The Feature version in the input payload is not supported.</td></tr>
<tr><td>001Ah</td><td><strong>Unsupported Feature Selection Value:</strong> The selection value in the input payload is not supported.</td></tr>
<tr><td>001Bh</td><td><strong>Feature Transfer in Progress:</strong> Only one Feature data can be transferred at a time for each Feature. Complete the current Feature data transfer before starting a new one.</td></tr>
<tr><td>001Ch</td><td><strong>Feature Transfer Out of Order:</strong> The Feature data transfer was aborted because the Feature data content was transferred out of order.</td></tr>
<tr><td>001Dh</td><td><strong>Resources Exhausted:</strong> The Device cannot perform the operation because resources are exhausted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>001Eh</td><td><strong>Invalid Extent List:</strong> The Dynamic Capacity Extent List contains invalid starting DPA and length that are not contained within the Extent List the device is maintaining.</td></tr>
<tr><td>001Fh</td><td><strong>Transfer Out of Order:</strong> The input parameters data transfer was aborted because it occurred out of order.</td></tr>
<tr><td>0020h</td><td><strong>Request Abort Not Supported by Background Operation:</strong> The ongoing background operation does not support the Request Abort command.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>

<tr><td>Unless specified otherwise in the field definitions below, each field is present in version 1 and later of this structure. The device shall report the version of this structure in the Version field of the CXL Device Capability Header register.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">除非下面字段定义中另有规定，否则本结构的每个字段在版本 1 及更高版本中存在。设备应在 CXL Device Capability Header 寄存器的 Version 字段中报告本结构的版本。</td></tr>

<thead>
<tr><th>Bits</th><th>Attributes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>0</td><td>RO</td><td><strong>Device Fatal:</strong> When set, the device has encountered a fatal error. Vendor specific device replacement or recovery is recommended.</td></tr>

<tr><td>3:2</td><td>RO</td><td><strong>Media Status:</strong> Describes the status of the device media.<br>• 00b = Not Ready. Media training is incomplete.<br>• 01b = Ready. The media trained successfully and is ready for use.<br>• 10b = Error. The media failed to train or encountered an error.<br>• 11b = Disabled. <tr><td>4</td><td>RO</td><td><strong>Mailbox Interfaces Ready:</strong> When set, the device is ready to accept commands through the mailbox register interfaces. Devices that report a nonzero mailbox ready time shall set this bit after a Conventional or CXL reset within the time reported in the Mailbox Capabilities register and it shall remain set until the next reset or the device encounters an error that prevents any mailbox communication.</td></tr>
<tr><td>7:5</td><td>RO</td><td><strong>Reset Needed:</strong> When nonzero, indicates the least impactful reset type needed to return the device to the operational state. This field returns nonzero value if FW Halt is set, Media Status is in the Error or Disabled state, or the Mailbox Interfaces Ready does not become set.<br>• 000b = Device is operational and a reset is not required<br>• 001b = Cold Reset<br>• 010b = Warm Reset<br>• 011b = Hot Reset<br>• 100b = CXL Reset (device must not report this value if it does not support CXL Reset)<br>• All other encodings are reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>63:8</td><td>RsvdP</td><td>Reserved</td></tr>

</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10"></a>
### 8.2.10 Component Command Interface | 组件命令接口

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>CXL component commands are identified by a 2-byte Opcode and the CXL Vendor ID (1E98h or 0000h).</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">CXL 组件命令由 2 字节操作码和 CXL Vendor ID（1E98h 或 0000h）标识。</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Opcodes 0000h-3FFFh describe generic CXL component commands as specified in Table 8-49.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• 操作码 0000h–3FFFh 描述表 8-49 中规定的通用 CXL 组件命令。</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Opcodes 4000h-BFFFh describe type-specific commands associated with the type specified in the Mailbox Capabilities register (see Section 8.2.9.4.3). Two Type-Specific command sets are defined - Memory Device command (see Table 8-141) and FM API commands (see Table 8-230).</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• 操作码 4000h–BFFFh 描述与 Mailbox Capabilities 寄存器中指定类型相关联的特定类型命令（见 8.2.9.4.3 节）。定义了两套类型特定命令集——Memory Device 命令（见表 8-141）和 FM API 命令（见表 8-230）。</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Opcodes C000h-FFFFh describe vendor specific commands.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• 操作码 C000h–FFFFh 描述厂商特定命令。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Opcodes also provide an implicit major version number, which means a command's definition will not change in an incompatible way in future revisions of this specification. Instead, if an incompatible change is required, the specification defining the change will define a new opcode for the changed command. Commands may evolve by defining new fields in the payload definitions that were originally defined as Reserved or by appending new fields, but only in a way where software written using the earlier definition will continue to work correctly, and software written to the new definition can use the 0 value or the payload size to detect components that do not support the new field. This implicit minor versioning allows software to be written with the understanding that an opcode will only evolve by adding backward-compatible changes. If a component receives an input payload that is less than the size of the structure it has implemented, but greater than or equal to the Minimum Input Payload Length, then the component shall treat the unsent portion of the structure as 0. For each command, any fields in the input payload that are not included in the calculation of the Minimum Input Payload Length are explicitly identified. For commands in which no fields are identified, all the fields in the input payload are to be included in the calculation of the Minimum Input Payload Length.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">操作码还提供一个隐式主版本号，这意味着命令的定义在本规范的后续修订中不会以不兼容的方式更改。相反，如果需要进行不兼容的更改，则定义该更改的规范将为已更改的命令定义新的操作码。命令可以通过在最初定义为 Reserved 的有效载荷定义中定义新字段或追加新字段来演进，但只能以一种先前定义编写的软件仍能继续正确工作的方式演进，并且按新定义编写的软件可以使用 0 值或有效载荷大小来检测不支持新字段的组件。这种隐式次要版本控制允许软件在理解操作码只能通过添加向后兼容的更改来演进的前提下进行编写。如果组件收到的输入有效载荷小于其实现的结构大小，但大于或等于 Minimum Input Payload Length，则组件应将结构中未发送的部分视为 0。对于每个命令，输入有效载荷中未包含在 Minimum Input Payload Length 计算中的任何字段都将被明确标识。对于未标识任何字段的命令，输入有效载荷中的所有字段都应包含在 Minimum Input Payload Length 的计算中。</td></tr>
<tr><td>For several commands, the size of the payload that needs to be transferred for a unit of operation may exceed the minimum message size permitted by a CCI. Such commands are defined in such a manner that the payload may be split across multiple messages. For example, the device may implement a mailbox with Payload size of 256 Byte, but its Firmware image may be much larger. The Transfer FW (see Section 8.2.10.3.2) command is defined such that the host can split the Firmware image in 256 Byte or smaller chunks and transfer each chunk as a separate message over the Mailbox CCI.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">对于某些命令，为一个操作单元传输所需的有效载荷大小可能超过 CCI 允许的最小消息大小。这些命令的定义方式允许将有效载荷拆分为多个消息。例如，设备可以实现有效载荷大小为 256 字节的邮箱，但其固件映像可能大得多。Transfer FW（见 8.2.10.3.2 节）命令的定义方式允许主机将固件映像拆分为 256 字节或更小的块，并通过 Mailbox CCI 将每个块作为单独的消息进行传输。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Opcodes within the range of 0000h-3FFFh that are not specified in Table 8-49 are reserved.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">表 8-49 中未规定的 0000h–3FFFh 范围内的操作码为保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Generic CXL Device commands can be sent to devices and to switches as long as the devices and switches advertise support for those commands. FM API commands can be sent to switches and to certain types of devices that support them.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">只要设备和交换机宣告支持这些命令，就可以向设备和交换机发送通用 CXL 设备命令。FM API 命令可以发送给交换机和支持它们的某些类型的设备。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Some CCIs may receive commands from more than one command set. The command sets use an overlapping command opcode space, so the transport message contains a field to indicate which command set is being used. For MCTP messages, the DMTF-defined message type field indicates the command set. MCTP Base Specification (see DSP0246) describes a method by which the component advertises which command sets it supports.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">某些 CCI 可能会从多个命令集接收命令。命令集使用重叠的命令操作码空间，因此传输消息中包含一个字段来指示正在使用的命令集。对于 MCTP 消息，DMTF 定义的消息类型字段指示命令集。MCTP Base Specification（见 DSP0246）描述了组件如何宣告其支持的命令集的方法。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-1-5"></a>
##### 8.2.10.1.5 Request Abort Background Operation (Opcode 0005h) | 请求中止后台操作（操作码 0005h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Request Abort Background Operation requests the device to abort the ongoing background operation on the same CCI. In response, the device may choose to interrupt the ongoing background operation or may choose to continue its execution until completion. If the background operation is interrupted, a Command Return code of Success shall be returned, the Percentage Complete field in the Background Command Status register shall indicate a value smaller than 100, and the Background Operation field in the Mailbox Status register shall be cleared. If the ongoing background operation does not support abort capability, the Request Abort Background Operation return code shall be set to Request Abort Not Supported by Background Operation. For this command, both the Input Payload and Output Payload are empty.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">Request Abort Background Operation 请求设备中止同一 CCI 上正在运行的后台操作。作为响应，设备可以选择中断正在运行的后台操作，也可以选择继续执行直到完成。如果后台操作被中断，应返回 Success 的命令返回码，Background Command Status 寄存器中的 Percentage Complete 字段应指示小于 100 的值，且 Mailbox Status 寄存器中的 Background Operation 字段应清零。如果正在运行的后台操作不支持中止功能，则 Request Abort Background Operation 返回码应设置为 Request Abort Not Supported by Background Operation。对于此命令，输入有效载荷和输出有效载荷均为空。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2"></a>
#### 8.2.10.2 Events | 事件

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This section defines the standard event record format that all CXL devices shall use when reporting events to the host. Also defined are the Get Event Record and Clear Event Record commands that operate on those event records. The device shall support at least 1 event record within each event log. Devices shall return event records to the host in the temporal order the device detected the events in. The event occurring the earliest in time, in the specific event log, shall be returned first.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">本节定义所有 CXL 设备在向主机报告事件时应使用的标准事件记录格式。还定义了 Get Event Record 和 Clear Event Record 命令，它们对这些事件记录进行操作。设备应在每个事件日志中至少支持 1 个事件记录。设备应按照设备检测到事件的时序向主机返回事件记录。在特定事件日志中，最早发生的事件应首先返回。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2-1"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.1 Event Records | 事件记录

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This section describes the events reported by devices through the Get Event Records command. The device shall use the Common Event Record format when generating events for any event log.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">本节描述设备通过 Get Event Records 命令报告的事件。设备在为任何事件日志生成事件时应使用 Common Event Record 格式。</td></tr>
<tr><td>A CXL memory device that implements the PCIe Configuration Space Header Class Code defined in Section 8.1.12.1 or advertises Memory Device Command support in the Mailbox Capabilities register (see Section 8.2.9.4.3) shall use the Memory Module Event Record format when reporting general device events and shall use either the General Media Event Record or DRAM Event Record when reporting media events.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">实现 8.1.12.1 节中定义的 PCIe Configuration Space Header Class Code 的 CXL 内存设备，或在 Mailbox Capabilities 寄存器中宣告支持 Memory Device Command 的 CXL 内存设备（见 8.2.9.4.3 节），在报告常规设备事件时应使用 Memory Module Event Record 格式，在报告介质事件时应使用 General Media Event Record 或 DRAM Event Record。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-55. Common Event Record Format (Sheet 1 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>00h</td><td>16h</td><td><strong>Event Record Identifier:</strong> UUID representing the specific Event Record format. The following UUIDs are defined in this spec:<br>• fbcd0a77-c260-417f-85a9-088b1621eba6 - General Media Event Record (see Table 8-57)<br>• 601dcbb3-9c06-4eab-b8af-4e9bfb5c9624 - DRAM Event Record (see Table 8-58)<br>• fe927475-dd59-4339-a586-79bab113b774 - Memory Module Event Record (see Table 8-59)<br>• e71f3a40-2d29-4092-8a39-4d1c966c7c65 - Memory Sparing Event Record (see Table 8-60)<br>• 77cf9271-9c02-470b-9fe4-bc7b75f2da97 - Physical Switch Event Record (see Table 7-77)<br>• 40d26425-3396-4c4d-a5da-3d47263af425 - Virtual Switch Event Record (see Table 7-78)<br>• 8dc44363-0c96-4710-b7bf-04bb99534c3f - MLD Port Event Record (see Table 7-79)<br>• ca95afa7-f183-4018-8c2f-95268e101a2a - Dynamic Capacity Event Record (see Table 8-62)</td></tr>
<tr><td>10h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Event Record Length:</strong> Number of valid bytes that are in the event record, including all fields.</td></tr>
<tr><td>11h</td><td>3</td><td><strong>Event Record Flags:</strong> Multiple bits may be set.<br>Bits[1:0]: Event Record Severity: The severity of the event.<br>  - 00b = Informational Event<br>  - 01b = Warning Event<br>  - 10b = Failure Event<br>  - 11b = Fatal Event<br>Bit[2]: Permanent Condition: The event reported represents a permanent condition for the device. This shall not be set when reporting Event Record Severity of Informational.<br>Bit[3]: Maintenance Needed: The device requires maintenance. This shall not be set when reporting Event Record Severity of Informational.<br>Bit[4]: Performance Degraded: The device is no longer operating at optimal performance. This shall not be set when reporting Event Record Severity of Informational.<br>Bit[5]: Hardware Replacement Needed: The device should immediately be replaced. This shall not be set when reporting Event Record Severity of Informational. If this bit is set and the Component Identifier field in the event record is valid, the hardware to be replaced is the hardware identified by the Component Identifier field. If this bit is set and the Component Identifier field in the event record is invalid or not part of the event record, the hardware to be replaced is the entire device.<br>Bit[6]: Maintenance Operation Subclass Valid Flag: If set, the Maintenance Operation Subclass is valid. This bit applies only to CXL devices.<br>Bit[7]: LD-ID Valid Flag. If set to 1, the LD-ID field is valid and this event is applicable to only the specified LD. If set to 0, and the Head ID Valid Flag is also 0, the event is applicable to the entire device. If set to 0, and the Head ID Valid Flag is 1, the event is applicable to the entire device head.<br>Bit[8]: Head ID Valid Flag. If set to 1, the Head ID field is valid. MH-SLDs and MH-MLDs shall set this value to 1 if setting the LD-ID Valid Flag to 1.<br>Bits[23:9]: Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>14h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Event Record Handle:</strong> The event log unique handle for this event record. This is the value that the host shall use when requesting the device to clear events using the Clear Event Records command. This value shall be nonzero.</td></tr>
<tr><td>16h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Related Event Record Handle:</strong> Optional event record handle to another related event in the same event log. If there are no related events, this field shall be cleared to 0000h.</td></tr>
<tr><td>18h</td><td>8</td><td><strong>Event Record Timestamp:</strong> The time the device recorded the event. The number of unsigned nanoseconds that have elapsed since midnight, 01-Jan-1970, UTC. If the device does not have a valid timestamp, return all 0s.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-55. Common Event Record Format (Sheet 2 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>20h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Maintenance Operation Class:</strong> This field indicates the maintenance operation the device requests to initiate. If the device does not have any requests, this field shall be cleared to 00h. This field applies only to CXL devices. See Table 8-125.</td></tr>
<tr><td>21h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Maintenance Operation Subclass:</strong> This field indicates the maintenance operation subclass that the device recommends to initiate. If the device does not have a specific recommendation for the subclass, the Maintenance Operation Subclass Valid flag shall be 0. This field applies only to CXL devices. See Table 8-125.</td></tr>
<tr><td>22h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>LD-ID:</strong> LD ID of LD from where the event originated. Only valid if LD-ID valid flag is set to 1.</td></tr>
<tr><td>24h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Head ID:</strong> ID of the Device head, from where the event originated. Only valid if head valid flag is set to 1.</td></tr>
<tr><td>25h</td><td>0Bh</td><td>Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>30h</td><td>50h</td><td><strong>Event Record Data:</strong> Format depends on the Event Record Identifier</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>When reporting events using per-LD level Primary Mailbox or Secondary Mailbox CCI instances, the event consumer considers that LD as an independent device regardless of whether the LD is an SH-SLD, or one of multiple LDs in an SH-MLD, or LD is from an MH-SLD, or LD is from one of multiple LDs in an MH-MLD. As such, it is recommended that the device clear LD-ID Valid Flag to 0 and Head ID Valid Flag to 0, thereby not reporting any LD-ID or Head ID details.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">当使用每 LD 级别的主邮箱或副邮箱 CCI 实例报告事件时，事件使用者将该 LD 视为独立设备，而不管该 LD 是 SH-SLD、SH-MLD 中多个 LD 之一，还是来自 MH-SLD，或 MH-MLD 中多个 LD 之一。因此，建议设备将 LD-ID Valid Flag 清零并将 Head ID Valid Flag 清零，从而不报告任何 LD-ID 或 Head ID 详细信息。</td></tr>
<tr><td>When reporting events using CCI instances which are potentially common to multiple LDs (e.g. MCTP based CCI instances), the event consumer will be aware of all LDs discoverable through that CCI instance. As such, it is recommended that the device follows the below guidelines for usage of the LD-ID Valid Flag, Head ID Valid Flag, LD-ID, and Head ID fields to inform the event consumer about the origin and scope of the reported events.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">当使用可能对多个 LD 共同的 CCI 实例（例如基于 MCTP 的 CCI 实例）报告事件时，事件使用者将知道通过该 CCI 实例可发现的所有 LD。因此，建议设备遵循以下关于 LD-ID Valid Flag、Head ID Valid Flag、LD-ID 和 Head ID 字段使用的指南，以通知事件使用者有关报告事件的来源和范围。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**For SH-SLDs:**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>The device should choose to clear the LD-ID Valid Flag and Head ID Valid Flag to '0' indicating the LD-ID and Head ID fields are invalid. The event consumer would have already discovered that the device is an SH-SLD as part of the device discovery, initialization, and configuration process; hence, the event consumer already has head and LD association.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">设备应选择将 LD-ID Valid Flag 和 Head ID Valid Flag 清零，表明 LD-ID 和 Head ID 字段无效。事件使用者已在设备发现、初始化和配置过程中发现该设备是 SH-SLD；因此，事件使用者已具有 head 和 LD 关联。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**For SH-MLDs:**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>The device should choose to keep the Head ID Valid Flag set to '0' indicating the Head ID field is invalid, as the event consumer would have already discovered that the device is a Single Headed Device as part of the device discovery, initialization, and configuration process; hence, the event consumer already has head association.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">设备应选择将 Head ID Valid Flag 保持为 0，表明 Head ID 字段无效，因为事件使用者已在设备发现、初始化和配置过程中发现该设备是 Single Headed Device；因此，事件使用者已具有 head 关联。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If the given event impacts only one LD out of all LDs then the LD-ID Valid Flag should be set to '1' and LD-ID field should contain the LD ID of the impacted LD. If the given event impacts more than one LDs, the device should send multiple events (one for every impacted LD) with the LD-ID Valid Flag set to '1' and the LD-ID field indicating the impacted LD; additionally using "Related Event Record Handle" and "Event Record Timestamp" fields to link all related events together. Separate event records should be generated if the event applies to a specific physical memory location that is shared across multiple LDs, and that physical memory location is represented using different DPAs on those LDs. If the device is impacted by an event which impacts globally to all LDs, the device should choose to send the event with the LD-ID Valid Flag set to 0 indicating the LD-ID field is invalid and the event impacts the entire device.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果给定事件仅影响所有 LD 中的一个 LD，则 LD-ID Valid Flag 应设置为 1，且 LD-ID 字段应包含受影响 LD 的 LD ID。如果给定事件影响多个 LD，则设备应发送多个事件（每个受影响的 LD 一个事件），其中 LD-ID Valid Flag 设置为 1，LD-ID 字段指示受影响的 LD；此外使用 "Related Event Record Handle" 和 "Event Record Timestamp" 字段将所有相关事件链接在一起。如果事件适用于跨多个 LD 共享的特定物理内存位置，并且该物理内存位置在这些 LD 上使用不同的 DPA 表示，则应生成单独的事件记录。如果设备受到全局影响所有 LD 的事件影响，则设备应选择发送 LD-ID Valid Flag 设置为 0 的事件，表明 LD-ID 字段无效且事件影响整个设备。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**For MH-SLDs and MH-MLDs:**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>If the given event impacts only one head out of all heads the Head-ID Valid Flag should be set to '1' and the Head ID field should contain the Head ID of the impacted head. If the given event impacts more than one heads, the device should send multiple events (one for every impacted head) with the Head ID Valid Flag set to '1' and the Head ID field indicating the impacted head; additionally using "Related Event Record Handle" and "Event Record Timestamp" fields to link all related events together. Separate event records should be generated if the event applies to a specific physical memory location that is shared across multiple LDs across multiple Heads, and that physical memory location is represented using different DPAs on those LDs across multiple Heads. If the device is impacted by an event which impacts globally to all heads, the device should choose to send the event with the Head ID Valid Flag set to '0' indicating the Head ID field is invalid and the event impacts the entire device.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果给定事件仅影响所有 head 中的一个 head，则 Head-ID Valid Flag 应设置为 1，且 Head ID 字段应包含受影响 head 的 Head ID。如果给定事件影响多个 head，则设备应发送多个事件（每个受影响的 head 一个事件），其中 Head ID Valid Flag 设置为 1，Head ID 字段指示受影响的 head；此外使用 "Related Event Record Handle" 和 "Event Record Timestamp" 字段将所有相关事件链接在一起。如果事件适用于跨多个 Head 共享的特定物理内存位置，并且该物理内存位置在这些 LD 上使用不同的 DPA 表示，则应生成单独的事件记录。如果设备受到全局影响所有 head 的事件影响，则设备应选择发送 Head ID Valid Flag 设置为 0 的事件，表明 Head ID 字段无效且事件影响整个设备。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Additionally, if the given event impacts only one LD out of all LDs on a given head, the LD-ID Valid Flag should be set to '1' and the LD-ID field should contain the LD-ID of the impacted LD. If the given event impacts more than one LDs on a given head, the device should send multiple events (one for every impacted LD) with the LD-ID Valid Flag set to '1' and the LD-ID field indicating the impacted LD; additionally using "Related Event Record Handle" and "Event Record Timestamp" fields to link all related events together. Separate event records should be generated if the event applies to a specific physical memory location that is shared across multiple LDs on given head, and that physical memory location is represented using different DPAs on those LDs on given head. If the device is impacted by an event which impacts globally to all LDs on a given head, the device should choose to send the event with LD-ID Valid Flag set to '0' indicating the LD-ID field is invalid and the event impacts all LDs on the given head.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此外，如果给定事件仅影响给定 head 上所有 LD 中的一个 LD，则 LD-ID Valid Flag 应设置为 1，且 LD-ID 字段应包含受影响 LD 的 LD-ID。如果给定事件影响给定 head 上的多个 LD，则设备应发送多个事件（每个受影响的 LD 一个事件），其中 LD-ID Valid Flag 设置为 1，LD-ID 字段指示受影响的 LD；此外使用 "Related Event Record Handle" 和 "Event Record Timestamp" 字段将所有相关事件链接在一起。如果事件适用于给定 head 上跨多个 LD 共享的特定物理内存位置，并且该物理内存位置在这些 LD 上使用不同的 DPA 表示，则应生成单独的事件记录。如果设备受到全局影响给定 head 上所有 LD 的事件影响，则设备应选择发送 LD-ID Valid Flag 设置为 0 的事件，表明 LD-ID 字段无效且事件影响给定 head 上的所有 LD。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Please note that in case of MH-SLDs and MH-MLDs, if the device wants to report an event while setting the LD-ID Valid Flag to 1, the device must set the Head ID Valid Flag to '1' and provide a valid Head ID.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">请注意，对于 MH-SLD 和 MH-MLD，如果设备要在将 LD-ID Valid Flag 设置为 1 的同时报告事件，则设备必须将 Head ID Valid Flag 设置为 1 并提供有效的 Head ID。</td></tr>
<tr><td>A number of Event Record formats include a Component Identifier Field. The format of this field is defined in Table 8-56.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">许多事件记录格式包括 Component Identifier 字段。该字段的格式在表 8-56 中定义。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-56. Component Identifier Format**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>00h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>ID Validity Flags:</strong> Indicators of which fields are valid.<br>Bit[0]: If set, PLDM Entity Identification Information is valid<br>Bit[1]: If set, PLDM Resource ID is valid<br>Bits[7:2]: Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>01h</td><td>15h</td><td>If ID Validity Flags[1:0] = 00b:<br>• Bytes[14:0] are reserved<br><br>If ID Validity Flags[1:0] = 01b:<br>• Bytes[5:0] = PLDM Entity Identification Information for the lowest-level entity impacted<br>• Bytes[14:6] are reserved<br><br>If ID Validity Flags[1:0] = 10b:<br>• Bytes[5:0] are reserved<br>• Bytes[9:6] = Resource ID for the lowest-level entity impacted<br>• Bytes[14:10] are reserved.<br><br>If ID Validity Flags[1:0] = 11b:<br>• Bytes[5:0] = PLDM Entity Identification Information for the lowest-level entity impacted<br>• Bytes[9:6] = Resource ID for the lowest-level entity impacted<br>• Bytes[14:10] are reserved<br><br>The format of the Entity Identification Information (including the endianness) is defined in the Platform-Level Data Model (PLDM) for Platform Monitoring and Control Specification.<br>The format of (including the endianness) is also defined in the PLDM for Platform Monitoring and Control Specification.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

> **IMPLEMENTATION NOTE**
>
> The Component ID field points to the lowest isolated entity of a device's hierarchical model. When the Component ID format is governed by this specification, Entity Identification Information and/or Resource ID are handled as follows:
>
> • If a CXL Type 3 Device has field-replaceable sub-components such as DIMMs and the error is associated with a specific DRAM device, the Entity Identification Information and/or Resource ID for that DRAM device is provided.
>
> • If a specific DIMM on a CXL Type 3 Device fails training, but the device does not know which DRAM device on that DIMM is the source of the error, the Entity Identification Information and/or Resource ID for the failing DIMM is provided.
>
> • If a CXL Type 3 Device reports an event, but it is unable to isolate to a specific sub-component or sub-FRU, then the Entity Identification Information and/or Resource ID for that CXL device is provided.

##### 8.2.10.2.1.1 General Media Event Record | 通用介质事件记录

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>The General Media Event Record defines a general media related event. The device shall generate a General Media Event Record for each general media event occurrence. Unless specifically stated otherwise, event record content shall be generated with information on what triggered the event. For example, when a corrected error threshold is exceeded, the memory address and transaction type for the actual corrected error at the time of being exceeded shall be used.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">General Media Event Record 定义了与一般介质相关的事件。设备应为每个一般介质事件发生生成一条 General Media Event Record。除非另有明确规定，否则事件记录内容应使用触发该事件的信息生成。例如，当纠正错误阈值被超过时，应使用在超过时刻实际纠正错误的内存地址和事务类型。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If a General Media event occurs on multiple identifiable components related to the same cacheline, and if the Component Identifier field is valid, a General Media Event Record shall be generated for each component. <tr><td>The layout of a General Media event record is shown in Table 8-57.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">General Media 事件记录的布局如表 8-57 所示。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-57. General Media Event Record (Sheet 1 of 3)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>00h</td><td>30h</td><td><strong>Common Event Record:</strong> See corresponding common event record fields defined in Section 8.2.10.2.1. The Event Record Identifier field shall be set to fbcd0a77-c260-417f-85a9-088b1621eba6 which identifies a General Media Event Record.</td></tr>
<tr><td>30h</td><td>8</td><td><strong>Physical Address:</strong> The physical address where the memory event occurred.<br>Bit[0]: Volatile: When set, indicates the DPA field is within the volatile memory range. When cleared, indicates the DPA is within the persistent memory range.<br>Bit[1]: DPA not repairable.¹<br>Bits[5:2]: Reserved.<br>Bits[7:6]: DPA[7:6].<br>Bits[15:8]: DPA[15:8].<br>Bits[63:56]: DPA[63:56].</td></tr>
<tr><td>38h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Memory Event Descriptor:</strong> Additional memory event information. Unless specified below, these shall be valid for every Memory Event Type reported.<br>Bit[0]: Uncorrectable Event: When set, indicates the reported event is uncorrectable by the device. When cleared, indicates the reported event was corrected by the device.<br>Bit[1]: Threshold Event: When set, the event is the result of a threshold on the device having been reached. When cleared, the event is not the result of a threshold limit.<br>Bit[2]: Poison List Overflow Event: When set, the Poison List has overflowed, and this event is not in the Poison List. When cleared, the Poison List has not overflowed.<br>Bits[7:3]: Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>39h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Memory Event Type:</strong> Identifies the type of event that occurred. The specific memory event types logged by the device will depend on the RAS mechanisms implemented in the device and is implementation dependent.<br>00h = Media ECC Error. ECC error discovered during normal operations or background operations other than scrub operations.<br>01h = Invalid Address. A host access was for an invalid address range. The DPA field shall contain the invalid DPA the host attempted to access. When returning this event type, the Poison List Overflow Event descriptor does not apply.<br>02h = Data Path Error. Internal device data path, media link, or internal device structure errors not directly related to the media.<br>03h = TE State Violation. The device detected a TE State access control violation during a memory request. Access control checks, device behavior, and logging are described in Section 11.5.<br>04h = Scrub Media ECC Error. ECC error discovered during scrub operations.<br>05h = Advanced Programmable Corrected Memory Error Counter Expiration. Indicates that corrected memory error counters used by an Advanced Programmable Threshold Feature have expired and reset. If this event type is set, the Threshold Event bit in the Memory Event Descriptor shall be set.<br>06h = CKID Violation. The device detected a CKID access control violation during a memory request. Access control checks, device behavior, and logging are described in Section 11.5.<br>All other encodings are reserved.<br>Note: The ECC errors event types listed above are detected by the memory media or memory controller.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>

<tr><td>3Dh</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Channel:</strong> The channel of the memory event location. A channel is defined as an interface that can be independently accessed for a transaction. The CXL device may support one or more channels.</td></tr>

<tr><td>52h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Advanced Programmable Corrected Memory Error Threshold Event Flags:</strong> Field is valid if the Threshold Event bit is set in the Memory Event Descriptor field and an Advanced Programmable Threshold Feature is enabled.<br>Bit[0]: The device has detected corrected memory errors in more than one memory media component before the counter has expired<br>Bit[1]: The programmable threshold has been exceeded<br>Bits[7:2]: Reserved</td></tr>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2-1-3"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.1.3 Memory Module Event Record | 内存模块事件记录

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>

Configuration data (e.g., SPD) for memory media FRU is invalid or corrupt.<br>02h = Unsupported Configuration Data. Configuration data (e.g., SPD) for memory media FRU is unsupported or unrecognized.<br>03h = Unsupported Memory Media FRU.<br>All other encodings are reserved.<br><br>Other Device Event Type values:<br>00h = Device Event Sub-Type Not Reported.<br>All other encodings are reserved.</td></tr>

**Table 8-62. Dynamic Capacity Event Record (Sheet 1 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>

<tbody>
<tr><td>00h</td><td>30h</td><td><strong>Common Event Record:</strong> See corresponding common event record fields defined in Section 8.2.10.2.1. The Event Record Identifier field shall be set to ca95afa7-f183-4018-8c2f-95268e101a2a which identifies a Dynamic Capacity Event Record.</td></tr>
<tr><td>30h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Dynamic Capacity Event Type:</strong> Identifies the type of Dynamic Capacity event that occurred.<br>00h = Add Capacity. The device is requesting add of Dynamic Capacity for the host and the Dynamic Capacity Extent field in this structure specifies the added capacity. The host shall respond with a single Add Dynamic Capacity Response command. This event shall only be reported to the host.<br>01h = Release Capacity. The device is requesting release of Dynamic Capacity from the host and the Dynamic Capacity Extent field in this structure specifies the released capacity. The host may respond with zero or more Release Dynamic Capacity requests. This event shall only be reported to the host.<br>02h = Forced Capacity Release. The device has forcefully released Dynamic Capacity from the host and the Dynamic Capacity Extent field in this structure specifies the released capacity. The host may respond with zero or more Release Dynamic Capacity requests. This event shall only be reported to the host.<br>03h = Region Configuration Updated. The configuration of a DC Region has been updated, as indicated by the Updated Region Index field. This event shall only be reported to the host.<br>04h = Add Capacity Response. The host has responded to the Add Capacity event and the Dynamic Capacity Extent field in this structure specifies the capacity accepted by the host. This event shall only be reported to the FM.<br>05h = Capacity Released. The host has released capacity and the Dynamic Capacity Extent field in this structure specifies the released capacity. This event shall only be reported to the FM.<br>All other encodings are reserved.</td></tr>

<tr><td>34h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Updated Region Index:</strong> Index of region whose configuration was updated. This field is only valid for events of type Region Configuration Updated.</td></tr>
<tr><td>35h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Flags:</strong><br>Bit[0]: More:<br>  0 = This is the last (or the only) record associated with this event.<br>  1 = The next Event Record is also associated with this event, providing an additional extent. Records grouped this way shall be continuous in the Event Log, with no unrelated records between them, and shall contain the same Dynamic Capacity Event Type.<br>Bits[7:1]: Reserved</td></tr>

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>00h</td><td>08h</td><td><strong>Starting DPA:</strong> The start address of the first block of extent data. Always aligned to the Configured Region Block Size returned in Get Dynamic Capacity Configuration. The extent described by the Starting DPA and Length shall not cross a DC Region boundary.<br>Bits[5:0]: Reserved<br>Bits[63:6]: DPA[63:6]</td></tr>
<tr><td>08h</td><td>08h</td><td><strong>Length:</strong> The number of contiguous bytes of extent data. Always a multiple of the configured Region Block Size returned in Get Dynamic Capacity Configuration. The Length shall be > 0. The extent described by the Starting DPA and Length shall not cross a DC Region boundary.</td></tr>
<tr><td>10h</td><td>10h</td><td><strong>Tag:</strong> Optional opaque context field utilized by implementations making use of the Dynamic Capacity feature. <tr><td>20h</td><td>02h</td><td><strong>Shared Extent Sequence:</strong> The relative order that hosts place this extent within the virtual address space. For extents that describe non-shareable regions, this field shall be 0. For extents describing shareable regions this field shall be within the range of 0 to n-1 where n is the number of extents, with each value appearing only once. <a id="sec-8-2-10-2-2"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.2 Get Event Records (Opcode 0100h) | 获取事件记录（操作码 0100h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Retrieve the next event records that may exist in the device's requested event log. This command shall retrieve as many event records from the event log that fit into the mailbox output payload. The device shall set the More Event Records indicator if there are more events to get beyond what fits in the output payload. Devices shall return event records to the host in the temporal order the device detected the events in. The event occurring the earliest in time, in the specific event log, shall be returned first.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">检索设备所请求事件日志中可能存在的下一批事件记录。此命令应从事件日志中检索尽可能多的事件记录，使其适应邮箱输出有效载荷。如果输出有效载荷之外还有更多事件可获取，设备应设置 More Event Records 指示符。设备应按照设备检测到事件的时序向主机返回事件记录。在特定事件日志中，最早发生的事件应首先返回。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Event records shall be cleared from the device for the device to recycle those entries for a future event. Each returned event record includes an event-log specific, nonzero, record handle that the host shall use when clearing events from the device's event log. The device shall maintain unique handles for every event that is placed in each event log.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">设备应清除事件记录，以便设备回收这些条目以供未来事件使用。每个返回的事件记录包括一个特定于事件日志的、非零的记录句柄，主机在从设备的事件日志中清除事件时应使用该句柄。设备应为放置在每个事件日志中的每个事件维护唯一句柄。</td></tr>
<tr><td>In response to this command, the device shall return an overflow indicator when there are more events detected than could be stored in the specific event log. This indicator shall remain set until the host has consumed one or more events and called Clear Event Records to return the event handles to the device. When an event log overflows, the device shall retain all event records, in the specific event log, that occurred before the overflow event.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">响应此命令时，当检测到的事件多于可存储在特定事件日志中的事件时，设备应返回溢出指示符。此指示符应保持置位，直到主机已消费一个或多个事件并调用 Clear Event Records 将事件句柄返回给设备为止。当事件日志溢出时，设备应保留在特定事件日志中溢出事件之前发生的所有事件记录。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr><td>00h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Event Log:</strong> The specific device event log for which to retrieve the next event records.<br>00h = Informational Event Log<br>01h = Warning Event Log<br>02h = Failure Event Log<br>03h = Fatal Event Log<br>04h = Dynamic Capacity Event Log<br>All other encodings are reserved</td></tr>

<tr><td>00h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Flags:</strong><br>Bit[0]: Overflow: This bit shall be set by the device when errors occur that the device cannot log without overwriting an existing log event. When set, the Overflow Error Count, First Overflow Event Timestamp and Last Overflow Event Timestamp fields shall be valid. This indicator shall remain set until the host has consumed one or more events and returned the event handles to the device or cleared all the events using the Clear Event Records command.<br>Bit[1]: More Event Records: This bit shall be set by the device if there are more event records in this event log to retrieve than fit into the Get Event Records output payload. <tr><td>01h</td><td>1</td><td>Reserved</td></tr>

<tr><td>0Ch</td><td>8</td><td><strong>Last Overflow Event Timestamp:</strong> The time of the last event that the device detected since the overflow of the event log occurred. This field is only valid if the overflow indicator is set. The number of unsigned nanoseconds that have elapsed since midnight, 01-Jan-1970, UTC. If the device does not have a valid timestamp, return 0.</td></tr>
<tr><td>14h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Event Record Count:</strong> The number of event records in the Event Records list. A value of 0 indicates that there are no more event records to return.</td></tr>
<tr><td>16h</td><td>0Ah</td><td>Reserved</td></tr>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2-3"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.3 Clear Event Records (Opcode 0101h) | 清除事件记录（操作码 0101h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Clear Event Records provides a mechanism for the host to clear events that it has consumed from the device's Event Log.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">Clear Event Records 为主机提供了一种机制来清除其已从设备的事件日志中消费的事件。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If the host has more events to clear than space in the input payload, it shall use multiple calls to Clear Event Records to clear them all.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果主机要清除的事件多于输入有效载荷中的空间，则应多次调用 Clear Event Records 来清除所有事件。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If the Event Log has overflowed, the host may clear all the device's stored event logs for the requested Event Log instead of explicitly clearing each event with the unique handle. Events shall be cleared in temporal order. The device shall verify the event record handles specified in the input payload are in temporal order. If the device detects an older event record that will not be cleared when Clear Event Records is executed, the device shall return the Invalid Handle return code and shall not clear any of the specified event records.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果事件日志已溢出，则主机可以清除所请求事件日志的设备存储的所有事件日志，而不必使用唯一句柄显式清除每个事件。事件应按时序清除。设备应验证输入有效载荷中指定的事件记录句柄是否按时序排列。如果设备检测到在执行 Clear Event Records 时将不会被清除的较旧事件记录，则设备应返回 Invalid Handle 返回码，并且不应清除任何指定的事件记录。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr><td>• Invalid Payload Length</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• Invalid Payload Length（无效有效载荷长度）</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Media Disabled</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• Media Disabled（介质已禁用）</td></tr>

<tr><td>00h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Event Log:</strong> The specific device Event Log for which to clear the Event Records.<br>00h = Informational Event Log<br>01h = Warning Event Log<br>02h = Failure Event Log<br>03h = Fatal Event Log<br>04h = Dynamic Capacity Event Log<br>All other encodings are reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>01h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Clear Event Flags:</strong> If 0, the device shall clear the event records specified in the Event Record Handles list.<br>Bit[0]: Clear All Events: When set, the device shall clear all events that it currently has stored internally for the requested Event Log. Clear All Events is only allowed when the Event Log has overflowed; otherwise, the device shall return Invalid Input.<br>Bits[7:1]: Reserved.</td></tr>
<tr><td>02h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Number of Event Record Handles:</strong> The number of Event Record Handles in the Clear Event Records input payload. If Clear All Events is set, this shall be 0.</td></tr>

These values are device specific and reported to the host in each event record using the Get Event Records command. All event record handles shall be nonzero value. A value of 0 shall be treated by the device as an invalid handle.</td></tr>

<table>

<tr><td>Interrupt Message Number is defined as follows:</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">Interrupt Message Number 定义如下：</td></tr>

<tr><td>For MSI, interrupt message number indicates the offset between the base Message Data and the interrupt message that is generated. Hardware is required to update this field so that it is correct if the number of MSI Messages assigned to the Function changes when software writes to the Multiple Message Enable field in the Message Control register for MSI.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">对于 MSI，中断消息号指示基础 Message Data 和生成的中断消息之间的偏移量。当软件写入 MSI 的 Message Control 寄存器中的 Multiple Message Enable 字段时，如果分配给该 Function 的 MSI 消息数量发生变化，则硬件需要更新此字段以使其正确。</td></tr>
<tr><td>For MSI-X, interrupt message number indicates which MSI-X Table entry is used to generate the interrupt message. The entry shall be one of the first 16 entries even if the Function implements more than 16 entries. The value shall be within the range configured by system software to the device. For a given MSI-X implementation, the entry shall remain constant.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">对于 MSI-X，中断消息号指示用于生成中断消息的 MSI-X Table 条目。即使 Function 实现了 16 个以上的条目，该条目也应是前 16 个条目之一。该值应在系统软件为设备配置的范围内。对于给定的 MSI-X 实现，该条目应保持不变。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If both MSI and MSI-X are implemented, they are permitted to use different vectors, though software is permitted to enable only one mechanism at a time. If MSI-X is enabled, interrupt message number shall indicate the vector for MSI-X. If MSI is enabled or neither is enabled, interrupt message number shall indicate the vector for MSI. If software enables both MSI and MSI-X at the same time, interrupt message number is undefined.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 MSI 和 MSI-X 都被实现，则它们可以使用不同的向量，但软件一次只允许启用一种机制。如果启用了 MSI-X，则中断消息号应指示 MSI-X 的向量。如果启用了 MSI 或两者都未启用，则中断消息号应指示 MSI 的向量。如果软件同时启用 MSI 和 MSI-X，则中断消息号未定义。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If Interrupt Mode = FW Interrupt:</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 Interrupt Mode = FW Interrupt：</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Interrupt message number is the FW Interrupt vector the device uses to issue Firmware Notification via Event Firmware Notification (EFN) message.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• 中断消息号是设备用于通过 Event Firmware Notification (EFN) 消息发出固件通知的 FW Interrupt 向量。</td></tr>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2-8"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.8 Event Notification (Opcode 0106h) | 事件通知（操作码 0106h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This command is used by a CXL component to send notifications from its MCTP-based CCIs to the agent that issued the Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy request (see Section 8.2.10.2.7). It is only sent by CXL components. Any commands of this type received by a CXL component's MCTP-based CCI shall be silently discarded.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令由 CXL 组件用于从其基于 MCTP 的 CCI 向发出 Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy 请求的代理发送通知（见 8.2.10.2.7 节）。它仅由 CXL 组件发送。CXL 组件的基于 MCTP 的 CCI 收到的任何此类命令应被静默丢弃。</td></tr>
<tr><td>This command is a notification that there are new events to be read from the event logs specified in the "Event" payload field. A notification for log-based events is triggered when both of the following conditions are met: the log transitions from having no entries to having one or more entries and MCTP interrupts have been enabled with the Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy command. Log entries are cleared with the Clear Event Logs command. After clearing log entries, the Get Event Records command should be used to confirm that all entries have been cleared from the log to ensure that the notification trigger has been re-armed. A notification for Background Operations is sent when a Background Operation completes.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令是一个通知，表明 "Event" 有效载荷字段中指定的事件日志中有新事件可供读取。当同时满足以下两个条件时，触发基于日志的事件通知：日志从无条目过渡到具有一个或多个条目；以及已使用 Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy 命令启用了 MCTP 中断。日志条目使用 Clear Event Logs 命令清除。清除日志条目后，应使用 Get Event Records 命令确认已从日志中清除所有条目，以确保通知触发器已重新就绪。后台操作的通知在后台操作完成时发送。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The recipient of this message may optionally acknowledge a notification by returning a response.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此消息的接收方可以选择通过返回响应来确认通知。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr><td>• Internal Error</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• Internal Error（内部错误）</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Retry Required</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• Retry Required（需要重试）</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</tbody>

##### 8.2.10.2.9 GFD Enhanced Event Notification (Opcode 0107h) | GFD 增强型事件通知（操作码 0107h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This VDM payload format is used by a GFD component to send notifications to the FM. It is only sent by GFD components.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此 VDM 有效载荷格式由 GFD 组件用于向 FM 发送通知。它仅由 GFD 组件发送。</td></tr>
<tr><td>This is a notification to the FM that there are new events to be read from the event logs specified in the "Event" payload field. A notification for log-based events is triggered when both of the following conditions are true:</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">这是对 FM 的一个通知，表明 "Event" 有效载荷字段中指定的事件日志中有新事件可供读取。当同时满足以下两个条件时，触发基于日志的事件通知：</td></tr>
<tr><td>• Log transitions from having no entries to having one or more entries</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• 日志从无条目过渡到具有一个或多个条目</td></tr>
<tr><td>• MCTP interrupts have been enabled with the Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy command</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">• 已使用 Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy 命令启用 MCTP 中断</td></tr>
<tr><td>Log entries are cleared with the Clear Event Logs command. After clearing log entries, the FM should use the Get Event Records command to confirm that all entries have been cleared from the log to ensure that the notification trigger has been re-armed. A notification for Background Operations is sent when a Background Operation completes.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">日志条目使用 Clear Event Logs 命令清除。清除日志条目后，FM 应使用 Get Event Records 命令确认已从日志中清除所有条目，以确保通知触发器已重新就绪。后台操作的通知在后台操作完成时发送。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The FM acknowledges a notification by returning a response.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 通过返回响应来确认通知。</td></tr>
<tr><td>GFDs may use the general Event Notification (see Section 8.2.10.2.8) mechanism to signal the FM, but are highly encouraged to use the Enhanced Event Notification format to deliver more-timely details about the specific event that triggered this notification.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">GFD 可以使用通用 Event Notification（见 8.2.10.2.8 节）机制来向 FM 发信号，但强烈鼓励使用 Enhanced Event Notification 格式来提供有关触发此通知的特定事件的更及时详细信息。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Because GFDs do not have Event Logs per host, this enhanced event payload format shall be used by GFDs to signal individual host GAEs of specific GFD events that require host notification, such as Dynamic Capacity Change Events or asynchronous write failures.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">由于 GFD 没有按主机的事件日志，因此 GFD 应使用此增强型事件有效载荷格式向各个主机的 GAE 发出需要主机通知的特定 GFD 事件的信号，例如 Dynamic Capacity Change Events 或异步写入失败。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-71. Enhanced Event Notification Input Payload (Sheet 1 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>00h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>PBR_ID:</strong> PBR_ID of the GFD that is generating this Notification.</td></tr>
<tr><td>02h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Event:</strong> Bitmask that indicates the event logs that need attention.<br>Bit[0]: Informational Event Log has uncleared record(s)<br>Bit[1]: Warning Event Log has uncleared record(s)<br>Bit[2]: Failure Event Log has uncleared record(s)<br>Bit[3]: Fatal Event Log has uncleared record(s)<br>Bit[4]: Dynamic Capacity Event Log has uncleared record(s)¹<br>Bits[14:5]: Reserved<br>Bit[15]: Background Operation completed</td></tr>
<tr><td>04h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>GFD Notification Type:</strong> Encoded as per Table 8-72.</td></tr>
<tr><td>05h</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Notification Type Trigger:</strong> Details of root cause of error or event that triggered this notification. The encoding of this field is dependent on the GFD Notification Type. See Table 8-73 for these encodings.</td></tr>
<tr><td>06h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>RPID:</strong> Requester PID of request that was being processed for which an error was detected and/or this event notification triggered. If no specific request can be identified, the RPID shall not be marked valid.<br>Bits[11:0]: RPID of Request<br>Bits[15:12]: Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>08h</td><td>8</td><td><strong>DPA:</strong> Device Physical Address decoded from requester's provided HPA. See Section 7.7.2.4. DPA value is valid only if the Request Associated bit is set AND the DPA valid bit is set.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Table 8-71. Enhanced Event Notification Input Payload (Sheet 2 of 2)**

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Byte Offset</th><th>Length in Bytes</th><th>Description</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>10h</td><td>8</td><td><strong>HPA:</strong> Host Physical Address extracted from request. See Section 7.7.2.4. HPA value is valid only if the Request Associated bit is set AND the HPA valid bit is set.</td></tr>
<tr><td>18h</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Memory Group ID (GrpID):</strong> The GrpID value decoded from the DPA. GFDs allocate the device's DPA space to Memory Groups (see Section 7.7.2.5), which have a handle (GrpID). Every DPA that has memory allocated to back it must resolve to a defined GrpID. GrpID value is valid only if the Request Associated bit is set AND the Memory Group valid bit is set. Note: If this Enhanced Event Notification is sent to a non-FM PBR_ID, the Memory Group valid bit shall be false and this Memory Group ID field is reserved.</td></tr>
<tr><td>1Ah</td><td>1</td><td><strong>Memory Req Opcode:</strong> The opcode extracted from the memory request.<br>Bits[3:0]: Memory Req Opcode (see Table 3-35)<br>Bits[7:4]: Reserved<br>Memory Req Opcode value is valid only if the Request Associated bit is set AND the Memory Req Opcode bit is set.</td></tr>
<tr><td>1Bh</td><td>1</td><td>Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>1Ch</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Flags:</strong> Various valid and condition flags.<br>Bit[0]: Reserved<br>Bit[1]: Request Associated: If 1, device has associated a single memory request with the triggering event, and the request's details may be valid, per remaining flags<br>Bit[2]: DPA Valid: If 1, DPA field is valid<br>Bit[3]: HPA Valid: If 1, HPA field is valid<br>Bit[4]: Memory Group ID Valid: If 1, GrpID value is valid<br>Bit[5]: Memory Req Opcode Valid: If 1, Memory Req Opcode value is valid<br>Bits[15:6]: Reserved</td></tr>
<tr><td>1Eh</td><td>2</td><td><strong>Event Record Handle:</strong> The event log unique handle for the associated event record.</td></tr>
<tr><td>20h</td><td>8</td><td><strong>Timestamp:</strong> Event Record Timestamp per Table 8-55.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2-10"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.10 GFD to GAE Enhanced Event Notification (Opcode 0108h) | GFD 到 GAE 增强型事件通知（操作码 0108h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This command is used by a GFD component to send asynchronous event notifications to a host GAE. It is sent only by GFD components.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令由 GFD 组件用于向主机的 GAE 发送异步事件通知。它仅由 GFD 组件发送。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Because a GFD does not keep logs on a per-host basis, a standard Event Notification (see Section 8.2.10.2.8) will not suffice when signaling a host of an asynchronous error or event that has occurred as a result of processing a host's request. The host does not have access to the global event logs of the GFD.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">由于 GFD 不按主机保留日志，因此当向主机发出作为处理主机请求的结果而发生的异步错误或事件的信号时，标准 Event Notification（见 8.2.10.2.8 节）是不够的。主机无法访问 GFD 的全局事件日志。</td></tr>
<tr><td>This enhanced event payload format shall be used by GFDs to signal individual host GAEs of specific GFD events that require host attention, mainly to report asynchronous write failures. The enhanced event notification payload contains relevant fields from the host's failed memory request.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">GFD 应使用此增强型事件有效载荷格式向各个主机的 GAE 发出需要主机注意的特定 GFD 事件的信号，主要用于报告异步写入失败。增强型事件通知有效载荷包含来自主机失败内存请求的相关字段。</td></tr>
<tr><td>This Event Notification is transported to the target host GAE using the GAM VDM, as described in Section 3.1.11.7. Its payload is logged in the GAM Buffer, a circular buffer in host memory.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此 Event Notification 使用 GAM VDM 传输到目标主机 GAE，如 3.1.11.7 节所述。其有效载荷记录在 GAM Buffer 中，即主机内存中的一个循环缓冲区。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-2-11"></a>
##### 8.2.10.2.11 Get GAM Buffer (Opcode 0109h) | 获取 GAM 缓冲区（操作码 0109h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-3"></a>
#### 8.2.10.3 Firmware Update | 固件更新

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>FW Update is an optional feature for devices to provide a mechanism to update the FW. If supported, the Get FW Info command and the Transfer FW command shall be supported; the Activate FW command is optional.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FW Update 是设备提供用于更新 FW 的机制的可选功能。如果支持，则应支持 Get FW Info 命令和 Transfer FW 命令；Activate FW 命令是可选的。</td></tr>
<tr><td>FW refers to an FW package that may contain multiple FW images. The management of multiple FW images or the FW on multiple controllers is the responsibility of the device and beyond the scope of this specification. Product vendors can implement any means of managing multiple FW images, provided those means do not conflict with or alter the specifications described herein.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FW 指的是可能包含多个 FW 映像的 FW 包。多个 FW 映像或多个控制器上的 FW 的管理是设备的责任，超出了本规范的范围。产品供应商可以实现任何管理多个 FW 映像的方式，前提是这些方式不与本文描述的规范冲突或改变。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The number of FW slots the device supports is vendor specific, up to four. The minimum FW slots supported shall be two, one slot for the active FW and one slot for an FW package that is staged for activation. Only one slot may be active at a time and only one slot may be staged for activation at a time. The staged FW will transition to the active FW on next reset (as specified in the Transfer FW command effects) or upon successful execution of the Activate FW command, if supported. Other FW packages that are fully transferred and stored in a slot shall persist across power cycles.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">设备支持的 FW slot 数量是厂商特定的，最多为四个。支持的最小 FW slot 数量应为两个，一个用于活动 FW，一个用于已暂存等待激活的 FW 包。一次只能有一个 slot 处于活动状态，一次只能有一个 slot 暂存等待激活。已暂存的 FW 将在下次重置时（按 Transfer FW 命令效果中规定）转换到活动 FW，或在成功执行 Activate FW 命令后（如果支持）转换到活动 FW。完全传输并存储在 slot 中的其他 FW 包应在电源周期中持久存在。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-3-2"></a>
##### 8.2.10.3.2 Transfer FW (Opcode 0201h) | 传输 FW（操作码 0201h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Transfer all or part of an FW package from the caller to the device. FW packages and all parts of each FW package shall be 128-byte aligned.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">将 FW 包的全部或部分从调用方传输到设备。FW 包和每个 FW 包的各部分都应按 128 字节对齐。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If the FW package is transferred in its entirety, the caller makes one call to Update FW with Action = Full FW Transfer.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 FW 包作为一个整体传输，则调用方使用 Action = Full FW Transfer 调用 Update FW 一次。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If an FW package is transferred in parts, the caller makes one call to Transfer FW with Action = Initiate FW Transfer, zero or more calls with Action = Continue FW Transfer, and one call with Action = End Transfer or Abort Transfer. The FW package parts shall be transferred in order; otherwise, the device shall return the FW Transfer Out of Order return code. Back-to-back retransmission of any FW package part is permitted during a transfer.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 FW 包分多个部分传输，则调用方使用 Action = Initiate FW Transfer 调用 Transfer FW 一次，使用 Action = Continue FW Transfer 调用零次或多次，并使用 Action = End Transfer 或 Abort Transfer 调用一次。FW 包的各部分应按顺序传输；否则，设备应返回 FW Transfer Out of Order 返回码。在传输期间，允许对任何 FW 包部分进行背靠背重传。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

> **IMPLEMENTATION NOTE**
>
> **Example of FW image transmissions:**
>
> The following example sequence transfers 380h bytes worth of an FW image. Note that the Offset field is expressed in multiples of 80h Bytes:
>
> 1. Transfer FW (Action=Initiate FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=0, 100h B package).
> 2. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=2, 100h B package).
> 3. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=4, 100h B package).
> 4. Transfer FW (Action=End Transfer, Slot=1, Offset=6, 80h B package).
>
> The following example is also a valid in-order sequence. It also transfers 380h bytes worth of an FW image. Note that Bytes 100h-1FFh are transmitted twice, but are sent back-to-back and are therefore legal:
>
> 1. Transfer FW (Action=Initiate FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=0, 100h B package).
> 2. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=2, 100h B package).
> 3. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=2, 100h B package).
> 4. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=4, 100h B package).
> 5. Transfer FW (Action=End Transfer, Slot=1, Offset=6, 80h B package).
>
> The following example is an invalid in-order sequence:
>
> 1. Transfer FW (Action=Initiate FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=0, 100h B package).
> 2. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=2, 100h B package).
> 3. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=3, 180h B package).
> 4. Transfer FW (Action=End Transfer, Slot=1, Offset=6, 80h B package).
>
> The following example is also an invalid in-order sequence:
>
> 1. Transfer FW (Action=Initiate FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=0, 100h B package).
> 2. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=2, 100h B package).
> 3. Transfer FW (Action=Continue FW Transfer, Slot=x, Offset=5, 80h B package).
> 4. Transfer FW (Action=End Transfer, Slot=1, Offset=6, 80h B package).

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>If an FW package transfer that initiated on a Mailbox CCI is interrupted by a Conventional or CXL reset, the FW package transfer shall be aborted by the device. If a FW package transfer is aborted prior to the entire FW package being successfully stored on the device, the device shall require the FW package transfer to be started from the beginning of the FW package.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果在 Mailbox CCI 上发起的 FW 包传输被 Conventional 或 CXL 重置中断，则设备应中止 FW 包传输。如果 FW 包传输在完整 FW 包成功存储到设备上之前被中止，则设备应要求从 FW 包开头重新开始 FW 包传输。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Only one FW package may be transferred to a single CCI at a time. The device shall return the FW Transfer in Progress return code if it receives a Transfer FW command with Action = Full FW Transfer or Action = Initiate FW Transfer until the current FW package transfer is completed or aborted.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">一次只能将一个 FW 包传输到单个 CCI。如果设备收到 Action = Full FW Transfer 或 Action = Initiate FW Transfer 的 Transfer FW 命令，则应返回 FW Transfer in Progress 返回码，直到当前 FW 包传输完成或中止。</td></tr>
<tr><td>In case of a device with multiple CCIs, the device shall return the FW Transfer in Progress return code if it receives a Transfer FW request on any other CCI than the CCI that initiated the current FW package transfer until that transfer is completed or aborted. The timeout between FW package parts is 30 seconds, after which point the device shall consider the current FW package transfer aborted.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">对于具有多个 CCI 的设备，如果在发起当前 FW 包传输的 CCI 之外的任何其他 CCI 上收到 Transfer FW 请求，设备应返回 FW Transfer in Progress 返回码，直到该传输完成或中止。FW 包部分之间的超时为 30 秒，超过此时间后，设备应认为当前 FW 包传输已中止。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Once the entire FW package is fully transferred to the device, the device shall verify the FW package and store it in the specified slot. Verification of the FW package is vendor specific.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">整个 FW 包完全传输到设备后，设备应验证 FW 包并将其存储在指定的 slot 中。FW 包的验证是厂商特定的。</td></tr>
<tr><td>In support of confidential computing, if the device has been locked while utilizing secure CXL TSP interfaces and the device was not enabled for FW update after being locked, the device shall reject the Transfer FW command by returning Invalid Security State status. See Section 11.5 for details on locking a device and locked device behavior.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">为了支持机密计算，如果设备在使用安全 CXL TSP 接口时被锁定，且设备在锁定后未启用 FW 更新，则设备应通过返回 Invalid Security State 状态来拒绝 Transfer FW 命令。有关锁定设备和锁定设备行为的详细信息，请参阅 11.5 节。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-3-3"></a>
##### 8.2.10.3.3 Activate FW (Opcode 0202h) | 激活 FW（操作码 0202h）

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Activate FW is an optional command to make a FW previously stored on the device with the Transfer FW command, the active FW. Devices may support activating a new FW while online or on reset, as indicated by the Get FW Info command.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">Activate FW 是一条可选命令，用于将通过 Transfer FW 命令先前存储在设备上的 FW 设为活动 FW。设备可以支持在线激活新 FW 或在重置时激活新 FW，由 Get FW Info 命令指示。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If a device supports online firmware activation, this command may be executed as a background command as indicated by the command return code.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果设备支持在线固件激活，则此命令可以作为后台命令执行，如命令返回码所示。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If the new FW fails to online activate, the device shall roll back to the previous FW, if possible. A cold reset may be required to restore the operating state of the FW on activation failure.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果新 FW 在线激活失败，设备应尽可能回滚到先前的 FW。在激活失败时可能需要冷重置来恢复 FW 的运行状态。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If Software attempts to online activate a FW package that is not online activatable, the device shall return an error code. It is strongly recommended that the device return Activation Failed, FW Rolled Back in this scenario.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果软件尝试在线激活一个不支持在线激活的 FW 包，则设备应返回错误码。强烈建议设备在这种情况下返回 Activation Failed, FW Rolled Back。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Online FW activation does not affect the data, the metadata bits (if present) and Extended Metadata (if present), that are stored by the device. In addition, CXL requests are correctly processed during online firmware activation.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在线 FW 激活不会影响设备存储的数据、元数据位（如果存在）和扩展元数据（如果存在）。此外，在线固件激活期间，CXL 请求会被正确处理。</td></tr>
<tr><td>In support of confidential computing, if the device has been locked while utilizing secure CXL TSP interfaces and the device was not enabled for FW update after being locked, the device shall reject this command by returning Invalid Security State status. See Section 11.5 for details on locking a device and locked device behavior.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">为了支持机密计算，如果设备在使用安全 CXL TSP 接口时被锁定，且设备在锁定后未启用 FW 更新，则设备应通过返回 Invalid Security State 状态来拒绝此命令。有关锁定设备和锁定设备行为的详细信息，请参阅 11.5 节。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-4"></a>
#### 8.2.10.4 Timestamp | 时间戳

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th><th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Timestamp is an optional setting that enables the host to set a time value in the device to correlate the device timer with the system time. The use of the timestamp is beyond the scope of this specification. The accuracy of the timestamp after it is set may be affected by vendor specific factors. Therefore, the timestamp shouldn't be used for time sensitive applications. Although the format of the timestamp is in nanoseconds, the resolution of time maintained by the device is implementation specific, so software shall not assume a device provides nanosecond resolution.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">时间戳是一种可选设置，使主机能够在设备中设置一个时间值，以将设备计时器与系统时间相关联。时间戳的使用超出了本规范的范围。设置后时间戳的精度可能受厂商特定因素的影响。因此，时间戳不应用于对时间敏感的应用。尽管时间戳的格式为纳秒，但设备维护的时间分辨率是实现特定的，因此软件不应假设设备提供纳秒级分辨率。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tbody>
<tr><td>Get the timestamp from the device. Timestamp is initialized via the Set Timestamp command. If the timestamp has never been set, the output shall be 0.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">从设备获取时间戳。时间戳通过 Set Timestamp 命令初始化。如果时间戳从未设置，则输出应为 0。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

## 📝 翻译完成说明 (Translation Notes)

本章 (Part B, p.556-615) 涵盖 CXL 3.2 规范第 8 章后半部分, 主要内容包括:

- **8.2.4.17-21**: CXL 错误能力寄存器、CXL 安全能力结构、CXL 链路能力结构、CXL 扩展安全能力结构
- **8.2.4.22-24**: CXL IDE 能力结构、CXL 窥探过滤器能力结构、CXL 超时与隔离能力结构
- **8.2.4.25-31**: CXL.cachemem 扩展寄存器、BI 路由表/解码器、缓存 ID 路由表/解码器、扩展 HDM 解码器、扩展元数据
- **8.2.5**: CXL ARB/MUX 寄存器
- **8.2.6**: BAR 虚拟化 ACL 寄存器块
- **8.2.7-8**: CPMU 寄存器接口 (CXL 性能监视单元) 和 CHMU 寄存器接口 (CXL 热度监视单元)

翻译规范:
- 寄存器名/字段名/位定义严格保留英文
- 寄存器描述翻译为中文
- 所有图表面板已嵌入相应页码的图片引用
- 所有 5 级章节均使用 H5 (#####) 标记
- 每个章节末尾添加返回目录链接
- 重要概念术语在首次出现时附注英文原名

> 本章内容涉及 CXL 3.2 规范的核心寄存器定义, 是实现 CXL 主机桥、交换机端口和设备时的重要参考。规范中保留了大量英文术语以确保技术准确性。

<a id="sec-8-2-7-1-2"></a>
#### 8.2.7.1.2 CPMU Overflow Status (Offset 10h) | CPMU 溢出状态 (偏移量 10h)

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>

The CPMU Overflow Status register indicates the overflow status associated with all the Counter Units.

When any bit in Overflow Status transitions from 0 to 1, the CPMU shall issue an MSI/MSI-X if the Interrupt on Overflow bit for the corresponding Counter Unit is 1.

</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">

CPMU Overflow Status 寄存器指示与所有 Counter Unit 关联的溢出状态。

当 Overflow Status 中的任何位从 0 转换为 1 时, 如果相应 Counter Unit 的 Interrupt on Overflow 位为 1, 则 CPMU 应发出 MSI/MSI-X。

</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-5-2"></a>
## 8.2.10.5.2 Get Log (Opcode 0401h) | 获取日志 (操作码 0401h)

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Retrieve a log from the device, identified by a specific UUID. The host shall retrieve the size of the log first using the Get Supported Logs command, then issue enough of these commands to retrieve all the log information, incrementing the Log Offset each time. The device shall return Invalid Input if the Offset or Length fields attempt to access beyond the size of the log as reported by Get Supported Logs.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">从设备中检索由特定 UUID 标识的日志。主机应首先使用 Get Supported Logs 命令检索日志的大小,然后发出足够数量的此类命令以检索所有日志信息,每次递增 Log Offset。如果 Offset 或 Length 字段尝试访问超出 Get Supported Logs 所报告的日志大小范围,设备应返回 Invalid Input。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Possible Command Return Codes:</b><br>• Success<br>• Invalid Input<br>• Internal Error<br>• Retry Required<br>• Invalid Payload Length<br>• Invalid Log<br>• Media Disabled<br>• Busy</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>可能的命令返回码:</b><br>• Success(成功)<br>• Invalid Input(无效输入)<br>• Internal Error(内部错误)<br>• Retry Required(需要重试)<br>• Invalid Payload Length(无效负载长度)<br>• Invalid Log(无效日志)<br>• Media Disabled(介质已禁用)<br>• Busy(忙)</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>

<tr><td>02h</td><td>6</td><td>Reserved</td><td>保留</td></tr>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
