<tr><td><b>Possible Command Return Codes:</b><br>• Success<br>• Unsupported<br>• Internal Error<br>• Retry Required</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>可能的命令返回码:</b><br>• Success(成功)<br>• Unsupported(不支持)<br>• Internal Error(内部错误)<br>• Retry Required(需要重试)</td></tr>

<tr><td>0h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bit[0]: Device Fatal: When set, the device has encountered a fatal error. Vendor specific device replacement or recovery is recommended.<br>• Bit[1]: FW Halt: When set, the device has encountered an FW error and is not responding.<br>• Bits[3:2]: Media Status: Describes the status of the device media.<br>— 00b = Not Ready. If the media is not in the Ready state, user data is not accessible.<br>• Bit[4]: Reserved.<br>• Bits[7:5]: Reset Needed: When nonzero, indicates the least impactful reset type needed to return the device to the operational state. A cold reset is considered more impactful than a warm reset. A warm reset is considered more impactful that a hot reset, which is more impactful than a CXL reset. This field returns a nonzero value if FW Halt is set, Media Status is in the Error or Disabled state, or the Mailbox Interfaces Ready bit does not become set.<br>— 000b = Device is operational and a reset is not required<br>— 001b = Cold Reset<br>— 010b = Warm Reset<br>— 011b = Hot Reset<br>— 100b = CXL Reset (device must not report this value if it does not support CXL Reset)<br>— All other encodings are reserved</td><td>• Bit[0]:Device Fatal(设备致命):设置时,设备遇到致命错误。建议进行供应商特定的设备更换或恢复。<br>• Bit[1]:FW Halt(FW 停止):设置时,设备遇到 FW 错误且无响应。<br>• Bits[3:2]:Media Status(介质状态):描述设备介质的状态。<br>— 00b = Not Ready(未就绪)。介质训练未完成。<br>— 01b = Ready(就绪)。介质已成功训练并可供使用。<br>— 10b = Error(错误)。介质训练失败或遇到错误。<br>— 11b = Disabled(已禁用)。对介质的访问被禁用。如果介质未处于 Ready 状态,则用户数据不可访问。<br>• Bit[4]:保留。<br>• Bits[7:5]:Reset Needed(需要复位):非零时,指示将设备恢复到操作状态所需的影响最小的复位类型。Cold Reset 被认为比 Warm Reset 影响更大。Warm Reset 被认为比 Hot Reset 影响更大,Hot Reset 被认为比 CXL Reset 影响更大。如果设置了 FW Halt、Media Status 处于 Error 或 Disabled 状态,或 Mailbox Interfaces Ready 位未变为设置状态,则此字段返回非零值。<br>— 000b = 设备正在运行,不需要复位<br>— 001b = Cold Reset<br>— 010b = Warm Reset<br>— 011b = Hot Reset<br>— 100b = CXL Reset(如果设备不支持 CXL Reset,则不得报告此值)<br>— 所有其他编码保留</td></tr>
<tr><td>1h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bits[3:0]: Negotiated Link Mode:<br>— 0h = Connection is not CXL or is disconnected<br>— 1h = RCD mode<br>— 2h = CXL 68B Flit and VH mode<br>— 3h = Standard 256B Flit mode<br>— 4h = CXL Latency-Optimized 256B Flit mode<br>— 5h = PBR mode<br>— All other encodings are reserved<br>• Bits[7:4]: Reserved.</td><td>• Bits[3:0]:Negotiated Link Mode(协商链路模式):<br>— 0h = 连接不是 CXL 或已断开<br>— 1h = RCD 模式<br>— 2h = CXL 68B Flit 和 VH 模式<br>— 3h = 标准 256B Flit 模式<br>— 4h = CXL 延迟优化的 256B Flit 模式<br>— 5h = PBR 模式<br>— 所有其他编码保留<br>• Bits[7:4]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>2h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bits[5:0]: Maximum Link Width: Value encoding matches the Maximum Link Width field in the PCIe Link Capabilities register in the PCIe Capability structure.<br>• Bits[7:6]: Reserved.</td><td>• Bits[5:0]:Maximum Link Width(最大链路宽度):值编码与 PCIe Capability 结构中 PCIe Link Capabilities 寄存器的 Maximum Link Width 字段相匹配。<br>• Bits[7:6]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>3h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bits[5:0]: Negotiated Link Width: Value encoding matches the Negotiated Link Width field in PCIe Link Capabilities register in the PCIe Capability structure.<br>• Bits[7:6]: Reserved.</td><td>• Bits[5:0]:Negotiated Link Width(协商的链路宽度):值编码与 PCIe Capability 结构中 PCIe Link Capabilities 寄存器的 Negotiated Link Width 字段相匹配。<br>• Bits[7:6]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>4h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bits[5:0]: Supported Link Speeds Vector: Value encoding matches the Supported Link Speeds Vector field in the PCIe Link Capabilities 2 register in the PCIe Capability structure.<br>• Bits[7:6]: Reserved.</td><td>• Bits[5:0]:Supported Link Speeds Vector(支持的链路速度向量):值编码与 PCIe Capability 结构中 PCIe Link Capabilities 2 寄存器的 Supported Link Speeds Vector 字段相匹配。<br>• Bits[7:6]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>5h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bits[5:0]: Max Link Speed: Value encoding matches the Max Link Speed field in the PCIe Link Capabilities register in the PCIe Capability structure.<br>• Bits[7:6]: Reserved.</td><td>• Bits[5:0]:Max Link Speed(最大链路速度):值编码与 PCIe Capability 结构中 PCIe Link Capabilities 寄存器的 Max Link Speed 字段相匹配。<br>• Bits[7:6]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>6h</td><td>1</td><td>• Bits[5:0]: Current Link Speed: Value encoding matches the Current Link Speed field in the PCIe Link Status register in the PCIe Capability structure.<br>• Bits[7:6]: Reserved.</td><td>• Bits[5:0]:Current Link Speed(当前链路速度):值编码与 PCIe Capability 结构中 PCIe Link Status 寄存器的 Current Link Speed 字段相匹配。<br>• Bits[7:6]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>7h</td><td>1</td><td>LTSSM State: Current link LTSSM Major state:<br>• 00h = Detect<br>• 01h = Polling<br>• 02h = Configuration<br>• 03h = Recovery<br>• 04h = L0<br>• 05h = L0s<br>• 06h = L1<br>• 07h = L2<br>• 08h = Disabled<br>• 09h = Loopback<br>• 0Ah = Hot Reset<br>• All other encodings are reserved<br>Link substates should be reported through vendor-defined diagnostics commands.</td><td>LTSSM State(LTSSM 状态):当前链路 LTSSM 主要状态:<br>• 00h = Detect<br>• 01h = Polling<br>• 02h = Configuration<br>• 03h = Recovery<br>• 04h = L0<br>• 05h = L0s<br>• 06h = L1<br>• 07h = L2<br>• 08h = Disabled<br>• 09h = Loopback<br>• 0Ah = Hot Reset<br>• 所有其他编码保留<br>链路子状态应通过供应商定义的诊断命令进行报告。</td></tr>
<tr><td>8h</td><td>1</td><td>First Negotiated Lane Number</td><td>First Negotiated Lane Number(首次协商的通道号)。</td></tr>
<tr><td>9h</td><td>2</td><td>Link State Flags<br>• Bit[0]: Lane Reversal State:<br>— 0 = Standard lane ordering<br>— 1 = Reversed lane ordering<br>• Bit[1]: Port PCIe Reset State (PERST#):<br>— 0 = Not in reset<br>— 1 = In reset<br>• Bit[2]: Port Presence Pin State (PRSNT#):<br>— 0 = Not present<br>— 1 = Present<br>• Bit[3]: Power Control State:<br>— 0 = Power on<br>— 1 = Power off<br>• Bits[15:4]: Reserved</td><td>Link State Flags(链路状态标志):<br>• Bit[0]:Lane Reversal State(通道反转状态):<br>— 0 = 标准通道顺序<br>— 1 = 反转的通道顺序<br>• Bit[1]:Port PCIe Reset State (PERST#)(端口 PCIe 复位状态):<br>— 0 = 未处于复位状态<br>— 1 = 处于复位状态<br>• Bit[2]:Port Presence Pin State (PRSNT#)(端口存在引脚状态):<br>— 0 = 不存在<br>— 1 = 存在<br>• Bit[3]:Power Control State(电源控制状态):<br>— 0 = 电源开启<br>— 1 = 电源关闭<br>• Bits[15:4]:保留</td></tr>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-9-10-8"></a>
##### 8.2.10.9.10.8 GFD Dynamic Capacity Add (Opcode 4907h) | GFD 动态容量添加 (操作码 4907h)

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This command adds Dynamic Capacity to the specified Memory Group ID (GrpID). It returns the list of all DC Extents that are mapped to the Memory Group ID.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令将 Dynamic Capacity 添加到指定的 Memory Group ID (GrpID)。它返回映射到 Memory Group ID 的所有 DC Extent 的列表。</td></tr>
<tr><td>A Selection Policy is specified to govern the device's selection of which memory resources to add:<br>• Free: Unassigned extents are selected by the device, with no requirement for contiguous blocks<br>• Contiguous: Unassigned extents are selected by the device and shall be contiguous<br>• Prescriptive: Extent list of capacity to assign is included in the request payload<br>• Enable Shared Access: Enable access to extent(s) previously added to another Memory Group in a region that reports the "Sharable" flag, as designated by the specified tag value</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">指定 Selection Policy 以管理设备对要添加的内存资源的选择:<br>• Free(空闲):由设备选择未分配的 extent,不要求连续块<br>• Contiguous(连续):由设备选择未分配的 extent,且应连续<br>• Prescriptive(指定):要分配的容量的 extent 列表包含在请求负载中<br>• Enable Shared Access(启用共享访问):启用对先前添加到报告"Sharable"标志的区域中另一个 Memory Group 的 extent 的访问,由指定的 tag 值指定</td></tr>
<tr><td>The FM might use the following example sequence to set up sharing of GFD Memory Groups between hosts:<br>• Issue GFD Dynamic Capacity Add Request with the GrpID for the associated Memory Group. The DC Region number must correspond to a region that is advertised as sharable and has the required memory attributes.<br>• If the above request is successful, all allowed hosts can be enabled for access to the new memory group, using the Set GFD SAT commands (see Section 7.7.2.5).<br>• The Set GFD SAT commands enable access by specific hosts to specific Memory Groups. The FM may enable the GFD to send a GFD Asynchronous Message VDM to the impacted hosts upon completion of a Set GFD SAT command. This notification causes each impacted host to reread the associated Extent Lists and thus learn of newly shared Extents.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 可以使用以下示例序列来设置主机之间 GFD Memory Groups 的共享:<br>• 使用关联 Memory Group 的 GrpID 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Add 请求。DC Region 编号必须对应于公布为可共享且具有所需内存属性的区域。<br>• 如果上述请求成功,可以使用 Set GFD SAT 命令(请参阅 7.7.2.5 节)为所有允许的主机启用对新内存组的访问。<br>• Set GFD SAT 命令启用特定主机对特定 Memory Groups 的访问。FM 可以使 GFD 在 Set GFD SAT 命令完成时向受影响的主机发送 GFD Asynchronous Message VDM。此通知使每个受影响的主机重新读取关联的 Extent Lists,从而了解新共享的 Extent。</td></tr>
<tr><td>If the FM is adding capacity to an already defined Memory Group, the current users (if any) of the Group are not automatically notified of a change in capacity. The FM can trigger such notifications from the GFD to the impacted hosts by reissuing the Set GFD SAT Entry command for each host with the Notify RPID bit set to 1 (see Section 8.2.10.9.10.14).</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 FM 正在向已定义的 Memory Group 添加容量,则该组的当前用户(如果有)不会自动收到容量更改的通知。FM 可以通过对每个主机的 Set GFD SAT Entry 命令重新发布 Notify RPID 位设置为 1 来触发从 GFD 到受影响的主机的此类通知(请参阅 8.2.10.9.10.14 节)。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The FM might use the following example sequence to allocate a set of tagged capacity and allow it to be initialized by a host in one Memory Group and then shared with one or more hosts as read-only in another sharable region.<br>1. Issue a GFD Dynamic Capacity Add with the Selection Policy set to Free or Contiguous or Prescriptive, with the Memory Group ID associated with the first host. The region number must correspond to a region that is advertised as writable and sharable.<br>2. If the above request is successful, the tagged sharable capacity can be initialized by the first host.<br>3. Issue a GFD Dynamic Capacity Add Reference for the tag associated with the capacity. Holding this Reference prevents the tagged capacity from being freed and sanitized in step 4.<br>4. After the first host has initialized the tagged sharable capacity, issue GFD Dynamic Capacity Release for the tag associated with the capacity. The capacity associated with the Tag is preserved but is not accessible from any Memory Groups.<br>5. Issue GFD Dynamic Capacity Add with Selection Policy set to Enable Shared Access with the Memory Group ID associated with the second host, specifying a region that is Sharable and read-only. The Tag field must match the Tag value used in step 1.<br>6. Any other hosts that need to share the tagged capacity can be added to the Memory Group specified in step 5.<br>7. Issue a GFD Dynamic Capacity Remove Reference to remove the FM reference to the tagged capacity.<br>8. To withdraw the shared capacity, issue a GFD Dynamic Capacity Release command for the Memory Group.<br>9. When the tagged capacity has been released from all hosts, if the FM does not hold a reference, the tagged capacity will be sanitized (if appropriate) and freed, at which point the tag no longer exists and the capacity is available for future use.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 可以使用以下示例序列来分配一组标记的容量,并允许它由一个 Memory Group 中的主机初始化,然后在另一个可共享区域中与一个或多个主机共享为只读。<br>1. 使用设置为 Free、Contiguous 或 Prescriptive 的 Selection Policy,使用与第一个主机关联的 Memory Group ID 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Add。区域编号必须对应于公布为可写且可共享的区域。<br>2. 如果上述请求成功,标记的可共享容量可由第一个主机初始化。<br>3. 为与该容量关联的 tag 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Add Reference。保持此引用可防止标记的容量在步骤 4 中被释放和清理。<br>4. 在第一个主机初始化了标记的可共享容量后,为与该容量关联的 tag 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Release。与 Tag 关联的容量被保留,但不能从任何 Memory Groups 访问。<br>5. 使用设置为 Enable Shared Access 的 Selection Policy,使用与第二个主机关联的 Memory Group ID 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Add,指定可共享且只读的区域。Tag 字段必须与步骤 1 中使用的 Tag 值匹配。<br>6. 需要共享标记容量的任何其他主机可以添加到步骤 5 中指定的 Memory Group。<br>7. 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Remove Reference 以删除 FM 对标记容量的引用。<br>8. 要撤回共享的容量,请为 Memory Group 发出 GFD Dynamic Capacity Release 命令。<br>9. 当标记的容量已从所有主机释放后,如果 FM 不保留引用,则标记的容量将被清理(如适用)并释放,此时 tag 不再存在,容量可供将来使用。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Invalid Input under the following conditions:<br>• When the command is sent with an invalid Memory Group ID, or an invalid region number, or an unsupported Selection Policy<br>• When the Length field is not a multiple of the Block size</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在以下情况下,此命令应失败并返回 Invalid Input:<br>• 当命令使用无效的 Memory Group ID、无效的区域编号或不受支持的 Selection Policy 发送时<br>• 当 Length 字段不是块大小的倍数时</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command, with selection policy Enable Shared Access, shall also fail with Invalid Input under the following conditions:<br>• When the specified region is not Sharable<br>• When the tagged capacity is already mapped to any Host Group via a non-Sharable region<br>• When the tagged capacity cannot be added to the requested region due to device-imposed restrictions<br>• When the same tagged capacity is currently accessible by the same Memory Group</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">使用 selection policy Enable Shared Access 的命令在以下情况下也应失败并返回 Invalid Input:<br>• 当指定区域不可共享时<br>• 当标记的容量已通过不可共享区域映射到任何 Host Group 时<br>• 由于设备施加的限制,标记的容量无法添加到所请求的区域时<br>• 当同一标记的容量当前可由同一 Memory Group 访问时</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Retry Required when the device determines that its FM CCI interface is already busy and cannot queue this command for execution at this time. (Forward progress of retried commands is beyond the scope of this specification.)</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">当设备确定其 FM CCI 接口已忙且此时无法将命令排队等待执行时,此命令应失败并返回 Retry Required。(重试命令的前进进度不在本规范的范围内。)</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Invalid Extent List under the following conditions:<br>• When the Selection Policy is set to Prescriptive and the Extent Count is invalid<br>• When the Selection Policy is set to Prescriptive and any of the DPAs are already accessible to the same Host Group</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在以下情况下,此命令应失败并返回 Invalid Extent List:<br>• 当 Selection Policy 设置为 Prescriptive 且 Extent Count 无效时<br>• 当 Selection Policy 设置为 Prescriptive 且任何 DPA 已可由同一 Host Group 访问时</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Resources Exhausted under the following conditions:<br>• When the length of the added capacity plus the current capacity present in all extents associated with the specified region exceeds the decode length for that region.<br>• If the total capacity requested cannot be added. The GFD shall not partially fulfill a GFD Dynamic Capacity Add request. These requests are 'All or Nothing' in nature, and the device shall atomically update impacted Extent Lists and Memory Groups upon success or leave them unchanged upon failure.<br>• There is insufficient contiguous space to satisfy a request with Selection Policy set to Contiguous.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在以下情况下,此命令应失败并返回 Resources Exhausted:<br>• 当所添加容量的长度加上与指定区域关联的所有 extent 中存在的当前容量超过该区域的解码长度时。<br>• 如果无法添加请求的总容量。GFD 不应部分满足 GFD Dynamic Capacity Add 请求。这些请求本质上是"全有或全无",设备应在成功时以原子方式更新受影响的 Extent Lists 和 Memory Groups,或在失败时使其保持不变。<br>• 没有足够的连续空间来满足 Selection Policy 设置为 Contiguous 的请求。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The device shall report Resources Exhausted if the Updated Extent List would cause the device to exceed its extent tracking ability.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 Updated Extent List 会导致设备超出其 extent 跟踪能力,设备应报告 Resources Exhausted。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Possible Command Return Codes:</b><br>• Success<br>• Unsupported<br>• Invalid Input<br>• Internal Error<br>• Retry Required<br>• Invalid Extent List<br>• Resources Exhausted</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>可能的命令返回码:</b><br>• Success(成功)<br>• Unsupported(不支持)<br>• Invalid Input(无效输入)<br>• Internal Error(内部错误)<br>• Retry Required(需要重试)<br>• Invalid Extent List(无效 Extent List)<br>• Resources Exhausted(资源耗尽)</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Command Effects:</b><br>• Immediate Configuration Change</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>命令效果:</b><br>• Immediate Configuration Change(立即配置更改)</td></tr>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-9-10-9"></a>
##### 8.2.10.9.10.9 GFD Dynamic Capacity Release (Opcode 4908h) | GFD 动态容量释放 (操作码 4908h)

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This command initiates the release of Dynamic Capacity from a GFD Memory Group. It returns the list of all DC Extents that are mapped to the Memory Group ID after this command was executed.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令启动从 GFD Memory Group 释放 Dynamic Capacity。它返回在此命令执行后映射到 Memory Group ID 的所有 DC Extent 的列表。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The FM is responsible for negotiating with all impacted hosts through out-of-band channels (beyond the scope of this specification) about the release of a DCD capacity in a GFD. After all impacted consumers have given up access attempts to the capacity to be reclaimed:<br>1. FM determines which Memory Group has capacity that needs to be reclaimed. The capacity of a Memory Group can be reduced, but only by reclaiming entire Extents. Further, if Extents are tagged (as they should be for all GFD allocations), tagged capacity should be reclaimed all at once. Thus, the FM must describe the capacity to be reclaimed as one or more sets of tagged extents.<br>2. Given the desired tagged extents, the FM must now negotiate with all impacted hosts through out-of-band channels (beyond the scope for this specification) about the release of any DCD capacity in a GFD.<br>3. After all impacted consumers have given up access attempts to the capacity to be reclaimed, the FM can issue the appropriate GFD Dynamic Capacity Release command for the targeted Memory Group with the list of tagged extents.<br>4. GFD will send the list of tagged extents that remain associated with the Memory Group in the response to the FM.<br>5. FM shall examine the remaining Extents of the Memory Group to validate that the correct capacity reduction has occurred. Because the FM had previously recalled all impacted capacity from the working images of the hosts, there should be no subsequent requests for these DPAs; thus, any capacity remaining within the Memory Group can still be in use.<br>6. If the Memory Group is devoid of any remaining capacity, the FM should remove all impacted hosts from the Memory Groups enabled list.<br>7. If the Memory Group has no remaining capacity, and no enabled RPIDs, the associated GrpID is automatically reclaimed to the 'unused' list by the GFD.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 负责通过带外信道(超出本规范的范围)与所有受影响的主机协商 GFD 中 DCD 容量的释放。在所有受影响的消费者放弃对要回收容量的访问尝试后:<br>1. FM 确定哪个 Memory Group 具有需要回收的容量。Memory Group 的容量可以减少,但只能通过回收整个 Extent 来减少。此外,如果 Extent 是带标签的(对于所有 GFD 分配应如此),则应一次性回收带标签的容量。因此,FM 必须将要回收的容量描述为一组或多组带标签的 extent。<br>2. 给定所需的带标签的 extent,FM 现在必须通过带外信道(超出本规范的范围)与所有受影响的主机协商 GFD 中任何 DCD 容量的释放。<br>3. 在所有受影响的消费者放弃对要回收容量的访问尝试后,FM 可以针对目标 Memory Group 使用带标签的 extent 列表发出相应的 GFD Dynamic Capacity Release 命令。<br>4. GFD 将在对 FM 的响应中发送仍与 Memory Group 关联的带标签的 extent 列表。<br>5. FM 应检查 Memory Group 的剩余 Extent 以确认已发生正确的容量减少。由于 FM 之前已从主机的工作映像中回收了所有受影响的容量,因此不应再有对这些 DPA 的后续请求;因此,Memory Group 内剩余的任何容量仍可使用。<br>6. 如果 Memory Group 没有任何剩余容量,FM 应从 Memory Groups 启用列表中删除所有受影响的主机。<br>7. 如果 Memory Group 没有剩余容量且没有启用的 RPID,则关联的 GrpID 由 GFD 自动回收至"未使用"列表。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The FM uses the following sequence to remove a host's access to shared GFD Memory Groups:<br>1. FM disables hosts' accesses to given Memory Groups, utilizing the Set GFD SAT command (see Section 8.2.10.9.10.14).<br>2. Set GFD SAT command enables or disables access by specific hosts, but it does not automatically notify the hosts that their access rights or any DCD capacity changes have been made. The FM can enable the GFD to send such notifications by setting the Notify RPID bit in the command request.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 使用以下序列来删除主机对共享 GFD Memory Groups 的访问:<br>1. FM 使用 Set GFD SAT 命令禁用主机对给定 Memory Groups 的访问(请参阅 8.2.10.9.10.14 节)。<br>2. Set GFD SAT 命令启用或禁用特定主机的访问,但它不会自动通知主机其访问权限或任何 DCD 容量已更改。FM 可以通过在命令请求中设置 Notify RPID 位来使 GFD 发送此类通知。</td></tr>
<tr><td>A removal policy is specified to govern the device's selection of which memory resources to remove:<br>• Tag-based: Extents are selected by the device based on tag, with no requirement for contiguous extents<br>• Prescriptive: Extent list of capacity to release is included in request payload</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">指定移除策略以管理设备对要移除的内存资源的选择:<br>• Tag-based(基于标签):由设备根据 tag 选择 extent,不要求连续的 extent<br>• Prescriptive(指定):要释放的容量的 extent 列表包含在请求负载中</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Invalid Input under the following conditions:<br>• When the command is sent with an invalid GrpID, or an invalid region number, or an unsupported Removal Policy<br>• When the command is sent with a Removal Policy of Tag-based and the input Tag does not correspond to any currently allocated capacity<br>• When Sanitize on Release is set but is not supported by the device</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在以下情况下,此命令应失败并返回 Invalid Input:<br>• 当命令使用无效的 GrpID、无效的区域编号或不受支持的 Removal Policy 发送时<br>• 当命令使用 Tag-based 的 Removal Policy 发送且输入的 Tag 与任何当前分配的容量不对应时<br>• 当设置了 Sanitize on Release 但设备不支持时</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Invalid Extent List under the following conditions:<br>• When the Removal Policy is set to Prescriptive and the Extent Count is invalid<br>• When the Removal Policy is set to Prescriptive and any extents are part of sharable, tagged capacity<br>• When the Extent List includes blocks that are not currently assigned to the region</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在以下情况下,此命令应失败并返回 Invalid Extent List:<br>• 当 Removal Policy 设置为 Prescriptive 且 Extent Count 无效时<br>• 当 Removal Policy 设置为 Prescriptive 且任何 extent 是可共享、带标签容量的一部分时<br>• 当 Extent List 包含当前未分配给该区域的块时</td></tr>
<tr><td>The command shall fail with Resources Exhausted when the length of the removed capacity exceeds the total assigned capacity for that region or for the specified tag when the Removal Policy is set to Tag-based.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">当所移除容量的长度超过该区域或指定 tag(当 Removal Policy 设置为 Tag-based 时)的总分配容量时,此命令应失败并返回 Resources Exhausted。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The device shall report Resources Exhausted if the Updated Extent List would cause the device to exceed its extent tracking ability.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">如果 Updated Extent List 会导致设备超出其 extent 跟踪能力,设备应报告 Resources Exhausted。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Possible Command Return Codes:</b><br>• Success<br>• Unsupported<br>• Invalid Input<br>• Internal Error<br>• Retry Required<br>• Invalid Extent List<br>• Resources Exhausted</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>可能的命令返回码:</b><br>• Success(成功)<br>• Unsupported(不支持)<br>• Invalid Input(无效输入)<br>• Internal Error(内部错误)<br>• Retry Required(需要重试)<br>• Invalid Extent List(无效 Extent List)<br>• Resources Exhausted(资源耗尽)</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Command Effects:</b><br>• Configuration Change after Cold Reset<br>• Immediate Configuration Change<br>• Immediate Data Change</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>命令效果:</b><br>• Configuration Change after Cold Reset(Cold Reset 后配置更改)<br>• Immediate Configuration Change(立即配置更改)<br>• Immediate Data Change(立即数据更改)</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-9-10-13"></a>
##### 8.2.10.9.10.13 Get GFD SAT Entry (Opcode 490Ch) | 获取 GFD SAT 条目 (操作码 490Ch)

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This command retrieves the GFD's SPID Access Table (SAT) entry for a specific RPID. The RPID is the PID that defines a CXL.mem request initiator. For a host, the RPID is the host's Edge Switch's USP PID. Note that a host and its associated CXL devices will each have a unique RPID, and therefore each will use a different entry in the GDT.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令检索特定 RPID 的 GFD SPID Access Table (SAT) 条目。RPID 是定义 CXL.mem 请求发起方的 PID。对于主机,RPID 是其 Edge Switch 的 USP PID。请注意,主机及其关联的 CXL 设备各自具有唯一的 RPID,因此每个将使用 GDT 中的不同条目。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The SAT entry is an N-bit vector (GrpAccVec). Each bitk of the GrpAccVec is the enable access control for a specific Memory Group ID (GrpID). Each memory request initiator is given access to a specific memory group number GrpID by setting bitk of the SAT vector, where k=GrpID. An SAT entry is therefore a list of Memory Groups to which a given memory requester (known by the given RPID) has access.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">SAT 条目是 N 位向量 (GrpAccVec)。GrpAccVec 的每个位 k 是对特定 Memory Group ID (GrpID) 的启用访问控制。通过设置 SAT 向量的位 k(其中 k=GrpID),每个内存请求发起方被授予对特定内存组编号 GrpID 的访问权限。因此,SAT 条目是给定内存请求者(由给定 RPID 标识)有权访问的 Memory Groups 的列表。</td></tr>
<tr><td>An FM enables multiple hosts and other requesters to share access to a given Memory Group by setting the corresponding Memory Group Mask bit in each requester's SAT entry.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 通过在每个请求者的 SAT 条目中设置相应的 Memory Group Mask 位,使多个主机和其他请求者能够共享对给定 Memory Group 的访问。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Possible Command Return Codes:</b><br>• Success<br>• Unsupported<br>• Invalid Input<br>• Internal Error<br>• Retry Required</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>可能的命令返回码:</b><br>• Success(成功)<br>• Unsupported(不支持)<br>• Invalid Input(无效输入)<br>• Internal Error(内部错误)<br>• Retry Required(需要重试)</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>Command Effects:</b><br>• None</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8"><b>命令效果:</b><br>• None(无)</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-9-10-14"></a>
##### 8.2.10.9.10.14 Set GFD SAT Entry (Opcode 490Dh) | 设置 GFD SAT 条目 (操作码 490Dh)

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>This command updates the GFD's SPID Access Table (SAT) entry for a specific RPID. The RPID is the PID that defines a CXL.mem request initiator. For a host, the RPID is the host's Edge Switch's USP PID. Note that a host and its associated CXL devices will each have a unique RPID, and therefore each will use a different entry in the GDT.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此命令更新特定 RPID 的 GFD SPID Access Table (SAT) 条目。RPID 是定义 CXL.mem 请求发起方的 PID。对于主机,RPID 是其 Edge Switch 的 USP PID。请注意,主机及其关联的 CXL 设备各自具有唯一的 RPID,因此每个将使用 GDT 中的不同条目。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The SAT entry is an N-bit vector (GrpAccVec). Each bitk of the vector is the enable access control for a specific Memory Group ID (GrpID). Each memory request initiator is given access to a specific memory group number GrpID by setting bitk of the SAT vector, where k=GrpID. An SAT entry is therefore a list of Memory Groups to which a given memory requester (known by the given RPID) has access. The FM grants specific memory requesters access to different Memory Groups by setting the corresponding Memory Group Mask bit in that requester's SAT entry.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">SAT 条目是 N 位向量 (GrpAccVec)。向量的每个位 k 是对特定 Memory Group ID (GrpID) 的启用访问控制。通过设置 SAT 向量的位 k(其中 k=GrpID),每个内存请求发起方被授予对特定内存组编号 GrpID 的访问权限。因此,SAT 条目是给定内存请求者(由给定 RPID 标识)有权访问的 Memory Groups 的列表。FM 通过在该请求者的 SAT 条目中设置相应的 Memory Group Mask 位,授予特定内存请求者对不同 Memory Groups 的访问权限。</td></tr>
<tr><td>An FM enables multiple hosts and other requesters to share access to a given Memory Group by setting the corresponding GrpAccVec bit in each requester's SAT entry.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 通过在每个请求者的 SAT 条目中设置相应的 GrpAccVec 位,使多个主机和其他请求者能够共享对给定 Memory Group 的访问。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The FM may enable the GFD to send a GFD Asynchronous Message VDM to the impacted hosts upon completion of a Set GFD SAT command. This notification causes each impacted host to reread the associated Extent Lists and thus learn of changed permissions.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">FM 可以使 GFD 在 Set GFD SAT 命令完成时向受影响的主机发送 GFD Asynchronous Message VDM。此通知使每个受影响的主机重新读取关联的 Extent Lists,从而了解已更改的权限。</td></tr>
<tr><td>This command shall return Invalid Input when any bit GrpAccVec[k] is set when k is larger than (max Memory Groups -1) because this attempts to enable a Memory Group that cannot exist.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">当任何位 GrpAccVec[k] 被设置且 k 大于(max Memory Groups -1)时,此命令应返回 Invalid Input,因为这会尝试启用无法存在的 Memory Group。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The device shall make single GrpAccVec updates atomically; the single GrpAccVec update is completely successful, or the failed attempt has no impact on the original GrpAccVec contents. If more than one GrpAccVec update is requested (i.e., more than one SPID's GrpAccVec is requested), each may atomically succeed, or fail. However, this command shall not return Success if multiple SAT GrpAccVec updates are requested and any one of them fails for any reason.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">设备应以原子方式执行单个 GrpAccVec 更新;单个 GrpAccVec 更新完全成功,或失败的尝试对原始 GrpAccVec 内容没有影响。如果请求多个 GrpAccVec 更新(即,请求多个 SPID 的 GrpAccVec),则每个可以原子方式成功或失败。但是,如果请求多个 SAT GrpAccVec 更新并且其中任何一个因任何原因失败,则此命令不应返回 Success。</td></tr>
<tr><td>In the event of an unsuccessful request of a multiple GrpAccVec update request, the FM should perform an appropriate Get GFD SAT Entry request to determine which of the requested updates were successful, and which were unsuccessful.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">在多 GrpAccVec 更新请求不成功的情况下,FM 应执行适当的 Get GFD SAT Entry 请求,以确定所请求的更新中哪些是成功的,哪些是不成功的。</td></tr>

<table>

The patrol scrub control allows the requester to configure patrol scrub configurations during system boot or at runtime.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">设备 Patrol Scrub 在正常设备运行期间主动定位并纠正错误。patrol scrub 控制允许请求者在系统引导时或运行时配置 patrol scrub 配置。</td></tr>

When the patrol scrub cycle duration is reported to the host via the Get Feature, the number of hours for the configured patrol scrub cycle returns the default value or the current value depending on the Selection field.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">patrol scrub 控制功能允许请求者指定 patrol scrub 周期必须完成的时数,前提是请求的时数不小于设备能够实现的 patrol scrub 周期的最小时数。此外,patrol scrub 控制允许主机禁用和启用 Patrol Scrub。通过 Get Feature 向主机报告 patrol scrub 周期持续时间时,所配置的 patrol scrub 周期的时数根据 Selection 字段返回默认值或当前值。</td></tr>
<tr><td>For memory errors that are detected during the patrol scrub, the CXL device shall generate either the General Media Event Record or the DRAM Event Record when the number of memory errors detected exceeds the configured threshold. For the DRAM Event Record, the Memory Event Type field is set to Scrub Media ECC error (01h). In both cases, Transaction Type field is set to Media Patrol Scrub (05h).</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">对于在 patrol scrub 期间检测到的内存错误,当检测到的内存错误数超过配置的阈值时,CXL 设备应生成 General Media Event Record 或 DRAM Event Record。patrol scrub 应处理不可纠正错误和可纠正错误。对于 General Media Event Record,Memory Event Type 字段设置为 Scrub Media ECC error (04h)。对于 DRAM Event Record,Memory Event Type 字段设置为 Scrub Media ECC error (01h)。在这两种情况下,Transaction Type 字段都设置为 Media Patrol Scrub (05h)。</td></tr>
<tr><td>Table 8-221 shows the information returned in the Get Supported Features output payload for the Device Patrol Scrub Control Feature. Some feature attributes are changeable.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">Table 8-221 显示了在 Get Supported Features 输出负载中为 Device Patrol Scrub Control Feature 返回的信息。某些功能属性是可更改的。</td></tr>

<tr><td>1h</td><td>2</td><td>Device Patrol Scrub Cycle Support<br>• Bits[7:0]: Number of Hours for the Configured Patrol Scrub Cycle: A nonzero value that represents the currently configured scrub cycle in hours. Legal value ranges from 01h to FFh.</td><td>Device Patrol Scrub Cycle Support(设备 Patrol Scrub 周期支持):<br>• Bits[7:0]:Number of Hours for the Configured Patrol Scrub Cycle(所配置 Patrol Scrub 周期的时数):表示当前配置的 scrub 周期(以小时为单位)的非零值。如果 Supported Feature Entry 中的 Set Feature Effects 字段设置为输出默认选择,则将显示默认的 patrol scrub 周期。如果 Set Feature Effects 字段设置为输出已保存选择,则将显示由主机请求更新的当前已保存的 patrol scrub 周期。<br>• Bits[15:8]:Smallest Number of Hours for the Patrol Scrub Cycle Supported by the Device(设备支持的 Patrol Scrub 周期的最小时数):指示设备可以支持的最短 scrub 间隔(以小时为单位)。合法值范围为 01h 到 FFh。</td></tr>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-9-11-2"></a>
##### 8.2.10.9.11.2 DDR5 Error Check Scrub Control Feature | DDR5 错误检查 Scrub 控制功能

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>The UUID of this feature is defined in Table 8-224.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">此功能的 UUID 在 Table 8-224 中定义。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The Error Check Scrub (ECS) is a feature defined in JEDEC DDR5 SDRAM Specification (JESD79-5) and allows the DRAM to internally read, correct single-bit errors, and write back corrected data bits to the DRAM array while providing transparency to error counts. The ECS control feature may be used to configure ECS parameters.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">错误检查 Scrub (ECS) 是 JEDEC DDR5 SDRAM 规范 (JESD79-5) 中定义的一项功能,允许 DRAM 内部读取、纠正单位错误,并将纠正后的数据位写回 DRAM 阵列,同时提供错误计数的透明性。ECS 控制功能可用于配置 ECS 参数。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The ECS control allows the requester to change the ECS threshold count provided that the request is within the definition specified in DDR5 mode registers, change the mode of operation between codeword count mode and row count mode, and reset the ECS counter.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">ECS 控制允许请求者更改 ECS 阈值计数(前提是请求在 DDR5 模式寄存器中指定的定义范围内),在码字数模式和行数模式之间更改操作模式,以及重置 ECS 计数器。</td></tr>
<tr><td>The outputs from the ECS operation including the error count and the row address with the most errors are accessible from the DDR5 ECS Log, defined in Table 8-90.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">ECS 操作的输出(包括错误计数和错误最多的行地址)可从 DDR5 ECS Log 访问,定义见 Table 8-90。</td></tr>
<tr><td>DDR5 ECS is able to handle corrected errors only. When a corrected error is fixed by ECS, the CXL device shall generate a DRAM Event Record or a Generic Media Event Record with the following attributes:<br>• Memory Event Type = Scrub Media ECC error (01h)<br>• Transaction Type = Internal Media Error Check Scrub (07h)</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">DDR5 ECS 只能处理可纠正错误。当 ECS 修复可纠正错误时,CXL 设备应生成具有以下属性的 DRAM Event Record 或 Generic Media Event Record:<br>• Memory Event Type = Scrub Media ECC error (01h)<br>• Transaction Type = Internal Media Error Check Scrub (07h)</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr><td>02h</td><td>1</td><td>Supported Corrected Volatile Memory Error (CVME) Threshold Configuration Flags<br>• Bit[0]: Corrected Error Type Filtering Supported: When set, the device is capable of filtering out corrected single bit errors and corrected multi-bit errors from its CVME counters used for advanced thresholding.<br>• Bit[1]: Patrol Scrub CVME Threshold Supported: When set, the device is capable of maintaining separate counters and thresholds for CVMEs detected during patrol scrub accesses. CVME counters used by Patrol Scrub CVME Thresholds are automatically reset at the end of every Patrol Scrub cycle.<br>• Bits[7:2]: Reserved.<br>Flags in this field apply to all severity thresholds (e.g., Informational, Warning, etc.). Feature does not support individual filtering per severity threshold.</td><td>Supported Corrected Volatile Memory Error (CVME) Threshold Configuration Flags(支持的 CVME 阈值配置标志):<br>• Bit[0]:Corrected Error Type Filtering Supported(支持可纠正错误类型过滤):设置时,设备能够从用于高级阈值的 CVME 计数器中过滤掉已纠正的单位错误和已纠正的多位错误。<br>• Bit[1]:Patrol Scrub CVME Threshold Supported(支持 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值):设置时,设备能够为在 patrol scrub 访问期间检测到的 CVME 维护单独的计数器和阈值。Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值使用的 CVME 计数器在每个 Patrol Scrub 周期结束时自动重置。<br>• Bits[7:2]:保留。<br>此字段中的标志适用于所有严重性阈值(例如,Informational、Warning 等)。功能不支持按严重性阈值进行单独过滤。</td></tr>
<tr><td>03h</td><td>1</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory (CVME) Error Threshold Configuration Flags<br>• Bit[0]: Single Bit Error Mask: When set, the device shall not include single bit errors in the corrected volatile memory errors count for the advanced programmable volatile memory error thresholds and subsequent memory media events associated with those thresholds.<br>• Bit[1]: Corrected Multi Bit Error Mask: When set, the device shall not include corrected multi-bit errors in the corrected volatile memory errors count for the advanced programmable volatile memory error thresholds and subsequent memory media events associated with those thresholds.<br>• Bit[2]: Enable Patrol Scrub CVME Threshold: When set, the device shall maintain separate counters and thresholds for CVMEs detected during patrol scrub. CVME counters used by Patrol Scrub CVME Thresholds are automatically reset at the end of every Patrol Scrub cycle. When cleared, the device shall combine CVME counts from patrol scrub and non-patrol scrub accesses. Additionally, when cleared, the device shall ignore all other parameters related to Patrol Scrub CVME Thresholds.<br>• Bit[3]: Enable Counter Expiration: When set, the device shall expire and restart all CVME counters used by the Advanced Programmable CVME Threshold Feature after a configured time duration. Counter expiration does not apply to Patrol Scrub CVME counters if Patrol Scrub Thresholds are enabled. If Patrol Scrub Thresholds are disabled, CVMEs counted by the patrol scrubber will reset alongside non-patrol scrub CVMEs when the counter expires.<br>• Bit[4]: Enable Counter Expiration Reporting: When set, the device shall generate a media event record each time the CVME counter has expired. Media event records are created with Informational severity and a flag to indicate Threshold Expiration. Counter expiration must be enabled and its timer input correctly configured for the device to report counter expiration. If the CVME count is 0 at the time of counter expiration, the device shall not generate a media event record. Use of this flag and a low expiration timer may yield a large number of events generated.<br>• Bits[7:5]: Reserved.<br>Flags in this field apply to all severity thresholds (e.g., Informational, Warning, etc.). Feature does not support individual filtering per severity threshold. Enabling all filters may still result in corrected error counting and thresholding for other error types not filterable by this feature.</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory (CVME) Error Threshold Configuration Flags(已配置的 CVME 错误阈值配置标志):<br>• Bit[0]:Single Bit Error Mask(单位错误掩码):设置时,设备不应将单位错误计入高级可编程易失性内存错误阈值以及与这些阈值关联的后续内存介质事件的已纠正易失性内存错误计数中。<br>• Bit[1]:Corrected Multi Bit Error Mask(已纠正多位错误掩码):设置时,设备不应将已纠正的多位错误计入高级可编程易失性内存错误阈值以及与这些阈值关联的后续内存介质事件的已纠正易失性内存错误计数中。<br>• Bit[2]:Enable Patrol Scrub CVME Threshold(启用 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值):设置时,设备应为在 patrol scrub 期间检测到的 CVME 维护单独的计数器和阈值。Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值使用的 CVME 计数器在每个 Patrol Scrub 周期结束时自动重置。清除时,设备应合并 patrol scrub 和非 patrol scrub 访问的 CVME 计数。此外,清除时,设备应忽略与 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值相关的所有其他参数。<br>• Bit[3]:Enable Counter Expiration(启用计数器到期):设置时,设备应在配置的持续时间之后使 Advanced Programmable CVME Threshold Feature 使用的所有 CVME 计数器到期并重新启动。如果启用了 Patrol Scrub 阈值,则计数器到期不适用于 Patrol Scrub CVME 计数器。如果禁用了 Patrol Scrub 阈值,则在计数器到期时,由 patrol scrubber 计数的 CVME 将与非 patrol scrub CVME 一起重置。<br>• Bit[4]:Enable Counter Expiration Reporting(启用计数器到期报告):设置时,设备应在 CVME 计数器每次到期时生成介质事件记录。介质事件记录以 Informational 严重性创建,并带有指示 Threshold Expiration 的标志。必须启用计数器到期并正确配置其计时器输入,设备才能报告计数器到期。如果在计数器到期时 CVME 计数为 0,则设备不应生成介质事件记录。使用此标志和较低的到期计时器可能会产生大量事件。<br>• Bits[7:5]:保留。<br>此字段中的标志适用于所有严重性阈值(例如,Informational、Warning 等)。功能不支持按严重性阈值进行单独过滤。启用所有过滤器仍可能导致此功能无法过滤的其他错误类型的已纠正错误计数和阈值。</td></tr>
<tr><td>04h</td><td>3</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory Error Counter Expiration Timer: Time in seconds after which the device shall expire and restart all corrected volatile memory error programmable counters. An input of 00 0000h shall render the expiration timer as disabled. Counter expiration does not apply to Patrol Scrub CVME counters if Patrol Scrub Thresholds are enabled.</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory Error Counter Expiration Timer(已配置的可纠正易失性内存错误计数器到期计时器):设备应到期并重新启动所有可纠正易失性内存错误可编程计数器的时间(以秒为单位)。输入 00 0000h 将使到期计时器禁用。如果启用了 Patrol Scrub 阈值,则计数器到期不适用于 Patrol Scrub CVME 计数器。</td></tr>

<tr><td>00h</td><td>1</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory Error Threshold Granularity<br>• 00h = Full HDM Range Granularity. When used, the programmable thresholds shall cover the entire range of HDM on the device. The device shall maintain a global CVME counter for the entire device HDM. When the global CVME counter exceeds a programmed threshold, the device shall generate a memory media event record.<br>• 01h = Per Memory Media FRU Granularity. When used, the programmable thresholds are at a per-memory media FRU granularity (e.g., threshold per DIMM) across all memory media FRUs. The device shall maintain a separate CVME counter for each memory media FRU connected to the device. When the CVME counter for a given memory media FRU exceeds a programmed threshold, the device shall generate a memory media event record.<br>• 02h = Per Rank Granularity. When used, the programmable thresholds are at a per-rank of device granularity (e.g., threshold per rank) across all ranks. The device shall maintain a separate CVME counter for each rank of media on the device. When the CVME counter for a given rank exceeds a programmed threshold, the device shall generate a memory media event record.<br>• All other encodings are reserved.</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory Error Threshold Granularity(已配置的可纠正易失性内存错误阈值粒度):<br>• 00h = Full HDM Range Granularity(完整 HDM 范围粒度)。使用时,可编程阈值应覆盖设备上的整个 HDM 范围。设备应为整个设备 HDM 维护一个全局 CVME 计数器。当全局 CVME 计数器超过编程阈值时,设备应生成内存介质事件记录。<br>• 01h = Per Memory Media FRU Granularity(每个内存介质 FRU 粒度)。使用时,可编程阈值在所有内存介质 FRU 中以每个内存介质 FRU 的粒度(例如,每个 DIMM 一个阈值)。设备应为连接到设备的每个内存介质 FRU 维护一个单独的 CVME 计数器。当给定内存介质 FRU 的 CVME 计数器超过编程阈值时,设备应生成内存介质事件记录。<br>• 02h = Per Rank Granularity(每个 Rank 粒度)。使用时,可编程阈值在所有 Rank 中以每个设备 Rank 的粒度(例如,每个 Rank 一个阈值)。设备应为设备上的每个介质 Rank 维护一个单独的 CVME 计数器。当给定 Rank 的 CVME 计数器超过编程阈值时,设备应生成内存介质事件记录。<br>• 所有其他编码保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>01h</td><td>1</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory (CVME) Error Threshold Configuration Flags: Flags in this field apply to all severity thresholds (e.g., Informational, Warning, etc.). Feature does not support individual filtering per severity threshold. Enabling all filters may still result in corrected error counting and thresholding for other error types not filterable by this feature.<br>• Bit[0]: Enable Single Bit Error Mask: When set, the device shall not include single bit errors in the corrected volatile memory errors count for the advanced programmable volatile memory error thresholds and subsequent memory media events associated with those thresholds.<br>• Bit[1]: Enable Corrected Multi Bit Error Mask: When set, the device shall not include corrected multi-bit errors in the corrected volatile memory errors count for the advanced programmable volatile memory error thresholds and subsequent memory media events associated with those thresholds.<br>• Bit[2]: Enable Patrol Scrub CVME Threshold: When set, the device shall maintain separate counters and thresholds for CVMEs detected during patrol scrub and non-patrol scrub accesses. CVME counters used by Patrol Scrub CVME Thresholds are automatically reset at the end of every Patrol Scrub cycle. When disabled, the device shall combine CVME counts from patrol scrub and non-patrol scrub accesses. Additionally, when disabled, the device shall ignore all other parameters related to Patrol Scrub CVME Thresholds.<br>• Bit[3]: Enable Counter Expiration: When set, the device shall expire and restart all CVME counters used by the Advanced Programmable CVME Threshold Feature after a configured time duration. Counter expiration does not apply to Patrol Scrub CVME counters if Patrol Scrub Thresholds are enabled. If Patrol Scrub Thresholds are disabled, CVMEs counted by the patrol scrubber will reset alongside non-patrol scrub CVMEs when the counter expires.<br>• Bit[4]: Enable Counter Expiration Reporting: When set, the device shall generate a media event record each time the CVME counter has expired. Media event records are created with Informational severity and a flag to indicate Threshold Expiration. Counter Expiration must be enabled and its timer input correctly configured for the device to report counter expiration. If the CVME count is 0 at the time of counter expiration, the device shall not generate a media event record.<br>• Bits[7:5]: Reserved.</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory (CVME) Error Threshold Configuration Flags(已配置的 CVME 错误阈值配置标志):此字段中的标志适用于所有严重性阈值(例如,Informational、Warning 等)。功能不支持按严重性阈值进行单独过滤。启用所有过滤器仍可能导致此功能无法过滤的其他错误类型的已纠正错误计数和阈值。<br>• Bit[0]:Enable Single Bit Error Mask(启用单位错误掩码):设置时,设备不应将单位错误计入高级可编程易失性内存错误阈值以及与这些阈值关联的后续内存介质事件的已纠正易失性内存错误计数中。<br>• Bit[1]:Enable Corrected Multi Bit Error Mask(启用已纠正多位错误掩码):设置时,设备不应将已纠正的多位错误计入高级可编程易失性内存错误阈值以及与这些阈值关联的后续内存介质事件的已纠正易失性内存错误计数中。<br>• Bit[2]:Enable Patrol Scrub CVME Threshold(启用 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值):设置时,设备应为在 patrol scrub 和非 patrol scrub 访问期间检测到的 CVME 维护单独的计数器和阈值。Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值使用的 CVME 计数器在每个 Patrol Scrub 周期结束时自动重置。禁用时,设备应合并 patrol scrub 和非 patrol scrub 访问的 CVME 计数。此外,禁用时,设备应忽略与 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值相关的所有其他参数。<br>• Bit[3]:Enable Counter Expiration(启用计数器到期):设置时,设备应在配置的持续时间之后使 Advanced Programmable CVME Threshold Feature 使用的所有 CVME 计数器到期并重新启动。如果启用了 Patrol Scrub 阈值,则计数器到期不适用于 Patrol Scrub CVME 计数器。如果禁用了 Patrol Scrub 阈值,则在计数器到期时,由 patrol scrubber 计数的 CVME 将与非 patrol scrub CVME 一起重置。<br>• Bit[4]:Enable Counter Expiration Reporting(启用计数器到期报告):设置时,设备应在 CVME 计数器每次到期时生成介质事件记录。介质事件记录以 Informational 严重性创建,并带有指示 Threshold Expiration 的标志。必须启用 Counter Expiration 并正确配置其计时器输入,设备才能报告计数器到期。如果在计数器到期时 CVME 计数为 0,则设备不应生成介质事件记录。<br>• Bits[7:5]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>02h</td><td>3</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory Error Counter Expiration Timer: Time in seconds after which the device shall expire and restart all corrected volatile memory error programmable counters. An input of 00 0000h shall render the expiration timer as disabled. Counter expiration does not apply to Patrol Scrub CVME counters if Patrol Scrub Thresholds are enabled.</td><td>Configured Corrected Volatile Memory Error Counter Expiration Timer(已配置的可纠正易失性内存错误计数器到期计时器):设备应到期并重新启动所有可纠正易失性内存错误可编程计数器的时间(以秒为单位)。输入 00 0000h 将使到期计时器禁用。如果启用了 Patrol Scrub 阈值,则计数器到期不适用于 Patrol Scrub CVME 计数器。</td></tr>

Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值将导致设备自动禁用由其他方法设置的任何 CVME 阈值(例如由 Set Alert Configuration 命令设置的阈值),无论 Non-Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值是否被禁用。每当禁用 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值时,这些其他 CVME 阈值不会自动重新启用。启用其他 CVME 阈值将导致设备自动禁用任何 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值。当禁用其他 CVME 阈值时,Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值也不会自动重新启用。<br>如果 Patrol Scrub CVME 阈值被禁用,则此参数的设置将被忽略。<br>• Bit[0]:Enable Programmable Informational Patrol Scrub Threshold(启用可编程 Informational Patrol Scrub 阈值):设置时,设备应启用高级可编程 informational patrol scrub 阈值,并生成与该阈值关联的任何 informational 内存介质事件记录。<br>• Bit[1]:Enable Programmable Warning Patrol Scrub Threshold(启用可编程 Warning Patrol Scrub 阈值):设置时,设备应启用高级可编程 warning patrol scrub 阈值,并生成与该阈值关联的任何 warning 内存介质事件记录。<br>• Bit[2]:Enable Programmable Failure Patrol Scrub Threshold(启用可编程 Failure Patrol Scrub 阈值):设置时,设备应启用高级可编程 failure patrol scrub 阈值,并生成与该阈值关联的任何 failure 内存介质事件记录。<br>• Bit[3]:Enable Programmable Hardware Replacement Flags for Warning Patrol Scrub Events(为 Warning Patrol Scrub 事件启用可编程 Hardware Replacement 标志):设置时,设备应使用 'Hardware Replacement Needed' 标志生成由高级可编程 warning patrol scrub 阈值引起的内存介质事件。<br>• Bit[4]:Enable Programmable Hardware Replacement Flags for Failure Patrol Scrub Events(为 Failure Patrol Scrub 事件启用可编程 Hardware Replacement 标志):设置时,设备应使用 'Hardware Replacement Needed' 标志生成由高级可编程 failure patrol scrub 阈值引起的内存介质事件。<br>• Bits[7:5]:保留。</td></tr>
<tr><td>10h</td><td>3</td><td>Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Informational Event Threshold: The device's programmable informational threshold for corrected volatile memory errors found by the patrol scrubber. A single memory media event record with informational severity is generated whenever the total number of patrol scrub CVMEs for the programmed threshold granularity becomes equal to or greater than this threshold value. The device may generate additional event records after the patrol scrub cycle has completed and restarted its counters. An input of 00 0000h shall render the Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Informational Event Threshold as disabled.</td><td>Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Informational Event Threshold(可编程 Patrol Scrub CVME Informational 事件阈值):设备对由 patrol scrubber 找到的可纠正易失性内存错误的可编程 informational 阈值。每当已编程阈值粒度的 patrol scrub CVME 总数等于或大于此阈值,就会生成一个具有 informational 严重性的内存介质事件记录。设备可能在 patrol scrub 周期完成并重新启动其计数器后生成其他事件记录。输入 00 0000h 将禁用 Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Informational Event Threshold。</td></tr>
<tr><td>13h</td><td>3</td><td>Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Warning Event Threshold: The device's programmable warning threshold for corrected volatile memory errors found by the patrol scrubber. A single memory media event record with warning severity is generated whenever the total number of patrol scrub CVMEs for the programmed threshold granularity becomes equal to or greater than this threshold value. The device may generate additional event records after the patrol scrub cycle has completed and restarted its counters. An input of 00 0000h shall render the Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Warning Event Threshold as disabled.</td><td>Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Warning Event Threshold(可编程 Patrol Scrub CVME Warning 事件阈值):设备对由 patrol scrubber 找到的可纠正易失性内存错误的可编程 warning 阈值。每当已编程阈值粒度的 patrol scrub CVME 总数等于或大于此阈值,就会生成一个具有 warning 严重性的内存介质事件记录。设备可能在 patrol scrub 周期完成并重新启动其计数器后生成其他事件记录。输入 00 0000h 将禁用 Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Warning Event Threshold。</td></tr>
<tr><td>16h</td><td>3</td><td>Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Failure Event Threshold: The device's programmable failure threshold for corrected volatile memory errors found by the patrol scrubber. A single memory media event record with failure severity is generated whenever the total number of patrol scrub CVMEs for the programmed threshold granularity becomes equal to or greater than this threshold value. The device may generate additional event records after the patrol scrub cycle has completed and restarted its counters. An input of 00 0000h shall render the Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Failure Event Threshold as disabled.</td><td>Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Failure Event Threshold(可编程 Patrol Scrub CVME Failure 事件阈值):设备对由 patrol scrubber 找到的可纠正易失性内存错误的可编程 failure 阈值。每当已编程阈值粒度的 patrol scrub CVME 总数等于或大于此阈值,就会生成一个具有 failure 严重性的内存介质事件记录。设备可能在 patrol scrub 周期完成并重新启动其计数器后生成其他事件记录。输入 00 0000h 将禁用 Programmable Patrol Scrub CVME Failure Event Threshold。</td></tr>
<tr><td>19h</td><td>7</td><td>Reserved</td><td>保留</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<a id="sec-8-2-10-10"></a>
### 8.2.10.10 FM API Commands | FM API 命令

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th width="50%">🇬🇧 English</th>
<th width="50%" style="background-color:#e8e8e8">🇨🇳 中文</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>CXL FM API commands are identified by a 2-byte Opcode as specified in Table 8-230. Opcodes also provide an implicit major version number, which means a command's definition shall not change in an incompatible way in future revisions of this specification. Instead, if an incompatible change is required, the specification defining the change shall define a new opcode for the changed command. Commands may evolve by defining new fields in the payload definitions that were originally defined as Reserved, but only in a way where software written using the earlier definition will continue to work correctly, and software written to the new definition can use the 0 value or the payload size to detect devices that do not support the new field. This implicit minor versioning allows software to be written with the understanding that an opcode shall only evolve by adding backward-compatible changes.</td><td style="background-color:#e8e8e8">CXL FM API 命令由一个 2 字节的 Opcode 标识,如 Table 8-230 中所指定。Opcode 还提供一个隐式的主版本号,这意味着命令的定义不应在本规范的未来修订版中以不兼容的方式更改。相反,如果需要进行不兼容的更改,则定义该更改的规范应为已更改的命令定义新的 Opcode。命令可通过在最初定义为保留的负载定义中定义新字段来发展,但只能以一种方式进行:使用早期定义编写的软件将继续正常工作,而使用新定义编写的软件可以使用 0 值或负载大小来检测不支持新字段的设备。这种隐式次要版本控制允许编写的软件理解 Opcode 应仅通过添加向后兼容的更改来发展。</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr><td></td><td></td><td>01h</td><td>Get VCS PID Access Vectors (Section 7.7.15.2)</td><td>5901h</td><td>P</td><td>P</td><td>P</td><td>MG</td></tr>

<tr><td></td><td></td><td>04h</td><td>Set VendPrefixL0 State (Section 7.7.15.5)</td><td>5904h</td><td>P</td><td>P</td><td>P</td><td>O</td></tr>

> **Notes for Table 8-230:**
>
> 1. O = Optional, P = Prohibited, MM = Mandatory for all MLD components (prohibited for SLD components), MO = Optional for MLD components (prohibited for SLD components), MMS = Mandatory for all MLD components that implement an MCTP-based CCI (prohibited for SLD components), MHO = Optional for Multi-Headed devices, MHS = Mandatory for all Multi-Headed devices that implement an MCTP-based CCI, DCO = Optional for DCDs, DCS = Mandatory for all DCDs that implement an MCTP-based CCI, MSW = mandatory on MCTP-based CCIs for all switches that support the FM API MCTP message type, MPSW = Mandatory for PBR Switches, MG = Mandatory for GAE.
> 2. Any host-visible LD in an MLD or MH-SLD or MH-MLD may implement FM Mailbox in a separate Function number. See Section 8.1.13.
> 3. CXL Fabric Manager API over MCTP Binding Specification (DSP0234).
> 4. A Mailbox CCI configured for FM use is permitted to also operate as a GAE. In such a case, these commands may optionally be supported.

> 1. O = Optional(可选),P = Prohibited(禁止),MM = Mandatory for all MLD components (prohibited for SLD components)(所有 MLD 组件必需(禁止用于 SLD 组件)),MO = Optional for MLD components (prohibited for SLD components)(MLD 组件可选(禁止用于 SLD 组件)),MMS = Mandatory for all MLD components that implement an MCTP-based CCI (prohibited for SLD components)(实现基于 MCTP 的 CCI 的所有 MLD 组件必需(禁止用于 SLD 组件)),MHO = Optional for Multi-Headed devices(多宿主设备可选),MHS = Mandatory for all Multi-Headed devices that implement an MCTP-based CCI(实现基于 MCTP 的 CCI 的所有多宿主设备必需),DCO = Optional for DCDs(DCD 可选),DCS = Mandatory for all DCDs that implement an MCTP-based CCI(实现基于 MCTP 的 CCI 的所有 DCD 必需),MSW = mandatory on MCTP-based CCIs for all switches that support the FM API MCTP message type(对支持 FM API MCTP 消息类型的所有交换机,在基于 MCTP 的 CCI 上是必需的),MPSW = Mandatory for PBR Switches(PBR 交换机必需),MG = Mandatory for GAE(GAE 必需)。
> 2. MLD 或 MH-SLD 或 MH-MLD 中的任何主机可见 LD 可在单独的 Function number 中实现 FM Mailbox。请参阅 8.1.13 节。
> 3. CXL Fabric Manager API over MCTP Binding Specification (DSP0234)。
> 4. 配置为 FM 使用的 Mailbox CCI 也允许作为 GAE 运行。在这种情况下,这些命令可以被选择性地支持。

> **IMPLEMENTATION NOTE**
>
> CXL components shall interpret the PCIe MMB Command Opcode Vendor ID = 1E98h or 0000h with CXL defined commands. 0000h is a PCI-SIG reserved value for legacy CXL compatibility. However, it is strongly recommended for callers to use the CXL Vendor ID (1E98h) to identify CXL defined commands.
>
> **实现说明:**
> CXL 组件应使用 CXL 定义的命令解释 PCIe MMB 命令操作码 Vendor ID = 1E98h 或 0000h。0000h 是 PCI-SIG 为传统 CXL 兼容性保留的值。但是,强烈建议调用方使用 CXL Vendor ID (1E98h) 来标识 CXL 定义的命令。
